title: Against Fear and Anxiety
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I denounce and renounce every doubt and every fear that is within me.
The fear of tomorrow, anxiety, I reject it in the name of Jesus.
Any agreement with fear, any agreement with anxiety, any agreement with doubt, Father, I renounce it today.
Father, remove fear consciousness from me.
Lord, remove the spirit of fear from me in Jesus name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce the fear that has been consuming my mind.
Uncertainty, I renounce it now, worry, I renounce it now.
Lord Jesus, I come and cast all my fears, all anxiety, and I release it at your feet.
You spirit of anxiety, you spirit of confusion, I command you to leave my life.
Spirit of worry, leave my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spirit that has been tormenting me, giving me sleepless nights, giving me anxiety of the future, today I destroy your power.
Seeds of fear, come out from me now in the name of Jesus.
Every seed of fear, I command you out now in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I return anxiety to the cross.
I return the fear of tomorrow to the cross, for I am delivered from all these things.
The spirit of fear is not my portion.
The fear of tomorrow, the fear of the future, anxiety is not my portion.
For I am clothed in Christ Jesus, I have the full armor of God upon me.
Father, give me the spirit of boldness.
Father, give me a sound mind, a mind that has no fear.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am coming out of fear, I am coming out of despair.
My assurance is in you, God, my rest is in you, God, my peace is in you, God.
I will not fear, I will not fear, Father.
Father, I have no reason to fear.
My days of anxiety are over in the mighty name of Jesus.
I receive what the Lord has prepared for me, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Depression and Heaviness
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I am before you, because Lord Jesus, you are the curse breaker, you are the God who delivers.
Lord Jesus, Son of God, have mercy upon me.
Deliver me, oh Lord, from every demonic oppression.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I rebuke the spirit of heaviness.
Father, I pull down depression, I pull down oppression.
Every mental blockage, every oppression and depression, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Whatever has made me to be heavy, whatever has made me to be sad and depressed, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, let your light pierce through.
Every dark cloud dissipate, every dark cloud be scattered, every dark cloud be removed in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every chain of oppression, every chain of depression, Father, I break it in the name of Jesus.
No chain will keep me in depression, no chain will keep me in sorrow.
I renounce depression, whatever it is, oh God, on my father's side, my mother's side, I renounce it.
Patterns of hopelessness, patterns of despair, patterns of depression, be broken now in the mighty name of Jesus.
I end sorrow in my life, I end pain in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, what reduced me to ashes, I am rising out of it.
I am rising out of shame, I am rising out of depression.
Depression and oppression has no place in my life.
Today I receive joy from on high, I receive the garment of praise from on high.
I have the garment of praise, I have the spirit of joy.
My spirit, my soul and my body is receiving strength from God.
Father, I receive joy from heaven, I receive gladness from heaven.
Thank you, Lord, for lifting every depressive spirit.
Thank you, Jesus, that the heaviness that was once there, now it's lightness.
Thank you, God, that my mind is clear again.
My days of depression are over in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am healed, I am delivered, I am free, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For a Sound Mind and Peace
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I call on your name.
Father, I want to know your ways, give me a sound mind.
Give me a sound mind, a mind that is full of love, a mind that has no fear.
Lord, cleanse my conscience, purify my mind, sanctify my thoughts.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today renew my mind.
Remove every program of the enemy within my mind.
Every thought that is not of God, thoughts of defeat, thoughts of death, thoughts of confusion, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let it be brought down.
Every stronghold in my mind, may it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every prison of my memories be broken in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every evil spirit that has deceived me that I shall not live in rest, I command that tormenting spirit to come out of my life.
You spirit of confusion, I command you to leave my life.
Every demonic pattern in my thoughts, let it be broken, let it be destroyed.
I silence every voice that came from my fathers, on both sides of my bloodline.
Every intrusive thought that affected my fathers that is now affecting me, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Whatever confusion of the devil, let it be pushed out now.
Let the sound of heaven begin to resound in my mind.
Father, in the name of Jesus, fortify my mind and fortify my spirit.
Cause for every heaviness and every cloud that is over my mind to be lifted now in the name of Jesus.
Let clarity come, oh God, let all condemnation be broken from me in the mighty name of Jesus.
God, regulate my mind and cause for me to be stable in you.
God, give me a sound mind so when circumstances begin to speak, I am not shaken.
Holy Spirit, regulate my emotions, Holy Spirit, regulate my thoughts.
Father, cause my mind to be stayed on you, so that I may maintain perfect peace in my life.
I am not going to dwell in chaos, but I am going to dwell in your peace.
My mind is stayed on you, oh Lord, my mind is stayed on you.
For I have the mind of Christ.
My mind is made up, my mind is renewed.
I receive the peace that surpasses all understanding, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: When I Am Weary and Discouraged
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you and I wait on you.
You are my strength, you are my salvation, you are my hope.
Father, I am tired, I am weary, I have carried so many burdens, but only you can give me rest.
You who are the giver of rest, may I receive rest today for my soul in the name of Jesus.
Father, I thank you for strength.
Take away all manner of discouragement.
Strengthen me, oh Lord, give me strength to be able to persevere.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every voice of discouragement, be thou cancelled in the name of Jesus.
That voice that says it is not working, that voice that says I should just quit, I cancel you in the name of Jesus.
Every place that discouragement occupied, I replace it with the hope of the spirit.
Every discouragement that wants to quench my zeal and my passion for life, no more after today.
Holy Spirit, give me the words to encourage myself with.
Holy Spirit, awaken the parts of me that have forgotten who you are.
Remind me of the victories that you have already given unto me.
Father, heal the parts of me that are broken.
Lord, today renew my strength in the areas of my life that I am weary.
Father, renew my spirit, renew my heart, renew my mind.
Strengthen me, not only spiritually, but also mentally, that I may be able to push through.
Cause me not to quit, God, cause me not to give up.
May the spirit of depression be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let new strength arise in me, let fresh grace arise in me.
Your joy will truly be my strength.
Father, today I receive new strength.
My God, you do not get weary, my Lord, you do not slumber.
I can do all things through Christ Jesus who strengthens me.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: Against Rejection and Shame
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, open my eyes to see the cross.
Jesus, you took upon yourself all the shame that I am experiencing today.
It is already on the cross, I do not need to be ashamed, because I am redeemed by you.
Lord, change my subconscious never to walk in condemnation.
Even if my heart condemns me, Lord God, you are greater than my heart.
Father, erase every lie, remove every word that is perverted in me.
Words of shame, words of humiliation, words that have made me feel worthless, Father, by your spirit, erase it from me.
Help me today not to walk in any title that a man has given me.
The voices that said I am a failure, the voices that said I am nobody, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
Every thought of rejection from you, Father, I cast it down in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of shame, today I divorce you, I separate myself from you.
I separate myself from every voice bringing up my past in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every curse of rejection, break in the name of Jesus.
Every evil scent that brings rejection, let it be removed now in the name of Jesus.
Let the spirit of shame be broken, let the spirit of defeat be broken in me.
Father, rescue me from shame, the shame of my own shortcomings.
Today turn me into a vessel of honor, a vessel that will bring you glory.
I am accepted by you, I am not rejected.
I am accepted by you, I am not rejected, I am redeemed by you.
I am not my past, I have been delivered from my past.
I come out of shame.
In the name of Jesus, shame is not my portion, the blessing of God is my portion.
My days of being rejected, my days of being slandered, have come to an end.
I am valuable, I am needed, for God has approved of me.
I am not alone, I am not forsaken, I am not abandoned.
Father, I thank you that my days of shame are over.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Peace
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes are set on you.
Lord, today I move my heart from worry.
I move my heart from anxiety.
Lord Jesus, you said that we should cast our burdens to you, that you will give us rest.
Lord, forgive me for taking my eyes off you and putting it on situations.
Father, recalibrate my mind today to focus on you.
Cause my mind to be stayed on you, so that I may maintain perfect peace in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, cause me to know your peace all around, just like Solomon.
Let me cease from every battle.
Let me cease from every trouble.
Let my mind know peace.
Father, as I keep my eyes on you, let me be kept in perfect peace.
Father, give me the strength to keep my peace.
I don't wrestle against flesh and blood.
Father, restore my soul.
May my soul return to the place of rest.
May I find peace again.
Every anxiety and worry be removed, I rest in you.
Every fear be dispelled by your love, I rest in you.
Let every conflict even within me be resolved.
Lord, I will myself to be in that place of peace.
I speak an atmosphere of peace.
My mind is stayed on you, oh Lord.
You are my peace, you are my rest.
I am in peace because Jesus is in my tomorrow.
In the name of Jesus, I decree and declare peace.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Comfort in Grief and Loss
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes look to you, my heart looks to you.
Lord God Almighty, have mercy on me, have pity on me.
Father, I don't understand what is happening, I don't understand it all.
I don't know why things happen, but you know everything.
Help me to understand your ways through this season of difficulty.
Through this fire, I pray for the spirit of comfort, I pray for peace through this whole storm.
Father, even in the valley of the shadow of death, Lord, be with me.
Let your presence not depart from me, let your spirit not depart from me.
Lord, don't leave me, remember your mercy concerning me.
Father, you said you will not leave me, but you will send your comforter.
Father, send your angels to strengthen me, like you strengthened your son Jesus.
Send your angels to comfort me.
Lord Jesus, strengthen me, build me up, fortify me through this difficult season.
Father, take away tears from my family, take away pain from my family.
Take away mourning from my family, take away heartbreak from my family.
Father, may every burden be lifted today, may every tear be taken away.
May every sorrow be removed from the memories of my mind, for all comfort comes from you.
Restore my soul to know the peace that only comes from you.
Cause my soul to rejoice again and wipe away my tears.
Father, bring closure where it needs to be, bring restoration and healing to my soul where it is broken.
Let torment be taken away from me in the name of Jesus.
I cancel every agenda of death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family.
Father, there will be no mourning in my family before the appointed time.
You allowed that moment so that I would know you as comforter.
Nothing that I place in you is lost, nothing that I entrust to you will fail.
I will not be afraid, Jesus will help me, and Jesus is my help.
In Jesus name, Amen.

title: When I Feel Alone
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes look to you, you are my help and my salvation.
If you don't rescue me, nobody can rescue me.
My brothers and sisters can forsake me, but you, O Lord Jesus, will never forsake me.
Lord, forgive me when I have looked at others to be my solutions, to be my help.
Lord Jesus, have mercy upon me, for too long I have carried these burdens by myself.
Remember me today, oh Lord, rescue me from where I am.
Father, I look to you, because you have my answers.
My father and my God, I want to be in your presence, your presence is my home.
Embrace me today, cover me under your wings today, keep me under your shadow today.
Father, I don't want to leave your presence unless you go with me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the grace to know your love, to experience that love.
So in times of uncertainty, in times of battles, in times of loneliness, I will remember that love.
I thought these troubles were because you have forsaken me, but now I know it is the opposite.
I know for sure that you love me, I receive your love today.
I thank you that your spirit has been joined to my spirit, so that I will never be separated from you.
You have desired to be near to me and have made the way possible for eternal communion with you.
Father, I fix my eyes on you, I set my heart on you.
No burden will blind me from your presence, no issue will remove me from communion with you.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I welcome angelic visitation.
From today, I am not alone, I am not alone.
I have legions upon legions of angels overseeing my life, keeping me in all my ways.
Father, I prophesy my days of trouble are over, my days of suffering are over.
I am not alone, I am not forsaken, I am not abandoned.
I am not forgotten, God knows my name.
As the Lord has declared, so shall it be.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: For Healing of My Body
segments: Lord Jesus, you are my healer.
Oh Lord, save me from this sickness, rescue me from these infirmities.
Father, I need mercy today, so that I may come out of this situation.
It is your great desire that I may be healed, that I may be made whole.
Lord Jesus, heal me, and I shall be healed.
Lord Jesus, restore me, and I shall be restored.
Forgive me for confessing that it is my sickness.
In the name of Jesus, I renounce every sickness, I renounce every suffering.
I renounce every covenant that has joined me to this pain, that has joined me to this evil spirit.
Father, today I make a distinction between me and sickness.
Anything that is independent of the Lord Jesus does not belong to me, it has no place in me.
In the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I bring every sickness into subjection.
Every disease in my body, whatever the name is, your hour has expired, and I command you out of my body now.
This is not your temple, this is the temple of the Lord Jesus Christ, and I shall live and I shall not die.
Holy Spirit, purify my blood.
Every genetic disease, every genetic sickness shall be broken today in the mighty name of Jesus.
Light be from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet.
Father, let your light dispel every darkness, every sickness be removed.
My body is receptive to divine intervention.
Lord Jesus, heal my body and restore my soul.
I will no longer be sick, no sickness shall destroy me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am made whole.
Father, from today, this affliction will never touch me again.
I receive my healing, I receive wholeness, I receive freedom, I receive my deliverance in the mighty name of Jesus.
Healing is my portion.
I am healed, I am restored, I am delivered, and I am made free today in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Nightmares and Night Attacks
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that your word is true.
Father, I accept your word today, your word that declares you never sleep nor slumber.
You are the God that watches over Israel.
Father, I desire that your angels be around me, I desire that your presence be with me.
Father, cover me today under your wings.
Father, I possess the night, I take control of the night.
Night and light are the same to you, light and darkness are equal to you.
I take charge of the darkness the same way I reign in the light.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever the enemy is trying to do, even at night when I sleep, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Everything the enemy is trying to do over my life, over my family, every night while I sleep, I cancel it.
Every sorcerer arising against my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let their charms be broken, let their altars be broken.
In the name of Jesus, every spirit that has been tormenting me, giving me sleepless nights, today I destroy your power.
Today I remove you from my life, by reason of the blood of Jesus, out of my life, out of my family.
Every vision that is from darkness, that is from the evil one, I arrest it.
I receive discernment to distinguish between that which is of God and that which is of darkness.
Every spiritual husband, every spiritual wife, I bind you and I remove you in the mighty name of Jesus.
Lord Jesus, if there is anything hiding in me, Lord Jesus, deliver me.
There will be no hiding place for demons.
Father, may I see the pillar of fire tonight, that all works of darkness be consumed and destroyed.
God gives sleep to his beloved.
I receive sleep, I receive rest in the name of Jesus.
From today, let there be no struggle, let there be no thoughts that will consume me and keep me up.
Let deep sleep fall over me, that it becomes my nature to just sleep.
I am under the shadow of the Almighty, my life is hidden in Christ, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every spell.
No arrow by day or by night will harm me or my family.
I take my sleep in Jesus name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For the Fruit of the Womb
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, your eyes can see me.
Today I receive your mercy and your love, I receive your compassion.
Lord Jesus, may your spirit overshadow me that I may conceive all that you have destined for me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, everything that is causing barrenness in my life, I reject it and I rebuke it.
Barrenness, you will no longer take refuge in my life.
My life will be fruitful.
In the name of Jesus, barrenness is cursed.
I condemn unfruitfulness, I completely condemn barrenness, this is not my portion today.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life, words of barrenness, words of failure.
You spirit that has been tormenting me, causing abnormal barrenness, I regulate my cycle, I remove barrenness from me in the mighty name of Jesus.
That abnormal hormonal balance in me, I correct it in the name of Jesus.
Every miscarriage, today it is over in the name of Jesus.
I will carry my child to full term.
It does not matter my age, it does not matter what the doctor said, nothing is impossible with the Lord Jesus.
My womb is restored, my eggs are restored.
May I carry as many children as I desire.
Father, from today, let fruitfulness manifest in my womb, fruitfulness in my body.
Remove every barrenness, remove every dryness, remove every wilderness.
Every drought ends from today, fruitfulness come forth.
Whether it is my womb I want opened, I speak to that mountain and command it to move out of my way.
Thank you that the spirit of barrenness is broken.
God is giving me descendants upon descendants.
Lord Jesus, I receive what I have been waiting to birth.
I receive an open womb.
I am fruitful in my body.
Barrenness has no place in my life, for the Lord has made me fruitful.
No more dryness, no more barrenness in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Generational Sickness
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive what is mine.
Healing is my portion, healing for my body, healing for my children.
Healing is my portion because I am an heir of Jesus Christ.
Redeem me, Lord, and I shall be redeemed.
Save me, Father, and I shall be saved from every sickness, from every infirmity, from every generational disease.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I separate myself from every sickness, from every condition.
In the name of Jesus, I cancel every chronic disease that is in my life, that is in my children, that is in my family.
Every chronic condition, be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Whether it is immediate family or distant family, in the mighty name of Jesus, I wipe out every chronic disease.
You demon, I arrest you in the name of Jesus and I pull you out of my family.
You have no place in my family; I evict you from my bloodline, I evict you from my children.
Every sickness that has been in my family from generation to generation, today I end it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I wipe out every chronic disease from my family name, from my bloodline, from my generations.
In the name of Jesus, every generational curse is broken.
No more generational curses, no more generational curses.
Generational curses end with me today; generational patterns end with me today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from generational curses.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am delivered from family curses.
Father, whatever was generational, whatever looked like a pattern, it ends because it dies in me today.
This infirmity will never touch me again; it will never touch my child again.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am no longer under a curse.
Today I am under the blessing of Jehovah.
Father, I begin a new chapter of wholeness and healing in the name of Jesus.
I open a chapter of long life.
From today let there be wholeness, from today let there be health.
Father, thank you for freedom, thank you for healing, thank you for wholeness in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against the Spirit of Infirmity
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, you are greater than my limitations.
Father, you can do all things, and you have power over all things.
All authority and power are yours, so there is no authority above you.
Father, I look to you, for without you I can do nothing.
You created my body; you created everything to do with me.
Forgive me for confessing that it is my sickness.
You never created anybody sick; you surely did not create me with sickness.
In the name of Jesus, I renounce every sickness, I renounce every suffering.
I renounce every covenant that has joined me to this pain, that has joined me to this evil spirit.
Whatever is in me that did not come from you, any power that is working against me, may it be broken over my life.
You unclean spirit that is working in my life, causing me sicknesses, causing infirmities, I command you by the power of the Holy Spirit, come out of my body.
Let that spirit of infirmity, no matter where it is located, come out of me now in the mighty name of Jesus.
Your time has expired in me.
You infirmity, you sickness, I break your power; you have no room in my life after now.
Every infirmity in my life, be broken in the name of Jesus.
My body is the temple of the living God; I command every entity living in me to be evicted out of my body.
Every spirit that has entered into my life, wherever it came from, it cannot afflict me.
Today I bind you, you evil spirit; I evict you from my life, go back to the pit.
Whatever damage was done, I command it to be reversed in the name of Jesus.
Break every hold, close every access point in the name of Jesus.
Today I renounce you, today I separate myself from you; you have no place in my life.
From today, this affliction will never touch me again; this infirmity will never touch me again.
I receive healing, I receive freedom, I receive deliverance.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am made whole.
I receive all that God has for me in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Cancelling Words I Spoke over My Body
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I switch directions.
Lord, have mercy upon my weak vessel.
Lord, purify my mouth.
Forgive me for confessing that it is my sickness.
You never created anybody sick.
You surely did not create me with sickness.
Father, I renounce even my own negative words today.
I separate myself from this sickness.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life.
Words of sickness, words of calamity, I reverse those words.
I reverse those words and I make those words of no effect.
I renounce every single curse that I have spoken over myself in the name of Jesus.
I cancel every negative word I have spoken over myself.
Every word that I spoke against myself, I reverse it, Lord Jesus.
Every time I spoke doubt, I reverse it.
Every time I spoke fear, I reverse it.
Every time I gave up on myself and I spoke those words, I reverse it, Lord Jesus.
Words I spoke as a child, words I have spoken as an adult, words I have spoken in pain, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Father, every idle word that I spoke out of woundedness, out of unforgiveness, out of anger, out of disappointment, I cancel it now in the name of Jesus.
The things that I might have uttered when I was angry, I renounce it.
Wherever fear spoke, I cancel it.
Everywhere where my confession agreed with the enemy, Father, I neutralize, I cancel, and I erase by reason of the blood of Jesus.
May every word that I spoke contrary to your word be reversed and cancelled now in Jesus name.
God, let your word concerning my health be established now.
I reverse them now in the name of Jesus, and I speak blessings over myself.
My strength is renewed.
My soul is restored.
Anything that I have declared of negativity over my life and my body, Father, I cancel that word right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Untimely Death
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, no premature death shall come close to my door.
I am under the shadow of the Almighty.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
Every untimely death, I draw the line by reason of the blood of Jesus.
You have no access to my life.
I arrest the spirit of death, I arrest the assignment of death, I abort the assignment of death in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever my name has been written for an untimely death, I wipe it out with the blood of Jesus.
Every pattern of premature death, every pattern of untimely death, I cancel it now.
Wherever you found a place in my bloodline, every pattern of premature death, I cancel you in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will not touch me, you will not afflict me, you will not visit my health, you will not visit my body.
You spirit of death, I command you in the name of Jesus, come out of my life.
Every spirit of death hiding in me, every root of death, every root of destruction, I command you now, your time has expired, come out of me.
Every accident that has been prepared for me or my family, every arrow that is targeting me in order to kill me before my time, I send you back to sender.
Every power of premature death is destroyed today.
In the name of Jesus, I cancel every assignment of premature death, every assignment to cut my purpose short, every assignment to cut destiny short.
I cancel every agenda of death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
I scatter you by fire in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spirit of death, I arrest you, I bind you, and I command you back to the pit.
Every spirit of death will be bound, every spirit of calamity will be bound, every spirit of tragedy will be bound.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I cancel appointments with the spirit of death.
Every appointment with death that has been arranged by the powers of darkness, that death is cancelled in the name of Jesus.
There will be no death before the fulfillment of purpose.
Premature death is not my portion.
I will not die prematurely.
I shall not die, I shall live to see the goodness of God in the land of the living.
I have a powerful destiny to fulfill in Christ.
Long life is my portion.
Father, I thank you for life and life more abundantly, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For a Safe Pregnancy and Delivery
segments: Father, as I call on your name right now, in the mighty name of Jesus, hear from heaven and answer my prayer.
Holy Spirit, fill me today, lead me and show me the way.
Lord, help me.
Father, heal your daughter, restore me and heal me.
Let this infirmity depart from me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Whatever this pregnancy complication is, I fix it in Jesus name.
Let my baby be positioned the right way in the name of Jesus.
Every intention of the enemy against my child, let it be reversed now.
I decree and declare by the spirit of the living God, whatsoever the condition is, I reverse it in the name of Jesus.
Whatever they told me concerning my baby will not be so.
Every unclean spirit will not touch me or my child in Jesus name.
You evil spirit, take everything you brought, every sickness, every curse, every nightmare, every torment.
From today you have no place in me and my baby, in Jesus name.
No demon in any form will appear to me or my child ever again.
I reverse every curse, and every situation that has been difficult is broken in the name of Jesus.
No more anxiety, no more nightmares, in Jesus name.
I will not be afraid, for the Lord will fight for me.
Father, rescue my child, secure my child, hide my child's life in Christ and in you.
May my child forever be secure, may my child forever be preserved.
May angels ascend and descend upon my child.
My pregnancy will be safe.
I will have my baby and I will be safe.
There shall be a beautiful delivery.
I will have a safe delivery.
May restoration come to me and my baby from today.
Whatever was dry, springs of living water shall begin to flow, beginning now.
Father, let it be so, let it be accomplished, let it be established in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Healing of My Mind and Emotions
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, give me a sound mind.
God, regulate my mind and cause for me to be stable in you.
Father, help me to manage my emotions.
Emotions have made me see the wrong way.
Father, help me, have mercy on me.
Lord, cleanse my conscience, purify my mind, sanctify my thoughts.
God, renew my mind, every thought of doubt, every thought of fear, every thought of self sabotage.
Every mental blockage, every oppression and depression, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Mentally, whatever is holding me back, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every foggy mind, every dullness of thinking, whatever sort of mental confusion, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, let your light pierce every darkness that has clouded my mind.
Today I break every worry that has afflicted my mind, I break every anxiety that has afflicted my mind.
Every spirit taking a hold of my mind, be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let every abandonment, fear and torment be removed from me in the name of Jesus.
Wherever my soul is wounded, I command it healed now.
Cause for every heaviness and every cloud that is over my mind to be lifted now in the name of Jesus.
Purify my mind, God, that where I have experienced trauma, experienced pain, let my mind be delivered from the bondage that comes with it.
Father, give me a clear conscience, remove every sort of guilt that is in me.
Today I forgive those who have been consuming my mind.
Today I let go of whatever was troubling me, and I set my mind on you.
I will no longer be led by my emotions, but I will be led by your spirit.
Father, fortify my mind and fortify my spirit.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I declare I have a sound mind.
I declare freedom over my mind, I declare liberty over my mind in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am unbreakable, I am unbroken in the name of Jesus.
The Lord has kept my mind.
I have the mind of Christ.
Let my mind be sure today, let my mind be safe today, in Jesus name. Amen.

title: For Strength and Renewed Energy
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I call upon your name, because you are the Lord who can renew my youth.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my strength is not enough.
My abilities are not enough, but your strength, your power is eternal, it is limitless.
I give you my strength in exchange for your strength.
Father, my strength is only weakness, but your strength perfects me.
Your word clearly says those who wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength.
Father, may I receive new strength.
Father, as your angels ministered unto your son Jesus and they strengthened him, I pray for supernatural energy.
I pray for supernatural strength, that strength that will carry me, that strength that will drive me.
I will have the strength to run and never be tired, I will have the strength to run and never faint.
Give me the ability to fulfill my purpose and to crush the spirit of slumber and to crush the spirit of delay.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I draw strength from you today, because you are my strength.
I am weak, oh Lord, strengthen me by your spirit.
Father, renew my youth today, restore the ability that was once within me.
Bring back life into my spirit, by your spirit, oh Lord, sustain me today and give me strength.
Father, send your angels to strengthen me, even as they did Christ Jesus, your son.
Father, let your angels minister unto me.
Father, let my spirit be strengthened, let my soul be strengthened, even my physical body be strengthened.
Any fatigue, any tiredness in me that has crept in today, let new strength arise in me, let fresh grace arise in me.
Every sickness that has crippled my energy, I command that condition to be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Everything that is used to shut me down today is broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, today in the name of Jesus, I receive renewed strength.
You who never slumber, you who never faint, you who never get weary, renew my strength today.
I will not be weary, I will not faint, I will not fall, I will not fail.
Father, in the name of Jesus, your strength is made perfect in my weakness, my Lord and my God.
I receive new strength, I receive boldness.
Today my strength is renewed in the truth of who you are.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: For My Marriage
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for grace, I thank you for mercy.
Oh God, have mercy on my family, Lord, have mercy on my home.
Look beyond my faults, God, and have mercy.
May your grace be upon my home, upon my marriage, upon my children.
I lay my marriage at your feet, Father.
I cannot change anyone, but you can change people, your spirit can change people.
Lord, I deliver my spouse in your hands.
The desire to be right in me, today I forfeit it, I let go of it.
That which I said concerning my spouse because I was angry, Lord, I renounce that.
Teach me to guide my mouth.
Father, whatever is causing division in my marriage, whatever is bringing strife in my home, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every root of contention, be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Any power trying to divide my family, any power trying to separate my family, by reason of the blood of Jesus, I scatter you by fire.
Leave my marriage, leave my relationship.
You will not destroy my spouse, you will not destroy our destiny in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spirit turning wife against husband, turning husband against wife, I pull you down today.
I evict you from my marriage.
I bring my home under the rulership of Christ.
I separate myself from every secret marriage, every demonic agreement, every demonic tie that is holding me.
Lord Jesus, secure my family today, that the enemy will have no way to destroy my family.
Every access point that the enemy has used before, today I shut every access.
Father, light up the fire of passion in my marriage.
Let it never be quenched, for your glory.
I speak resurrection to my marriage.
I speak wholeness, peace, joy in my marriage.
My marriage is revived, my family is restored.
Let my joy be full in my marriage, in Jesus name, Amen.

title: For a Godly Spouse
segments: Father, I thank you for the sacrifice of your son Jesus upon the cross for my restoration.
Every divine relationship that you have ordained for my life, I pray that you restore it.
Father, give me spiritual perception, oh God.
Father, that I will know them by the spirit, I will know no man by the flesh.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me discernment to know those who are sent for me.
Open my eyes to understand who you sent for me.
Father, I will not see the physical appearance, but I will recognize the spiritual grace that you have manifested in them.
Father, show me what relationship to engage in.
Father, in the name of Jesus, visit my marriage, visit my relationship, visit everything that has to do with me today.
Oh Lord, every demonic entanglement that has caused delays in my marriage, Father, by your spirit reverse it now.
Every spiritual husband, every spiritual wife, I bind you and I remove you out of my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
You spiritual husband, I arrest you, I bind you, I cause the ground that you are standing on to be on fire now.
I command you to be consumed, be consumed, be consumed.
Every wicked relationship through marriage, may it be scattered in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every wicked relationship designed to delay my life, designed to confuse my life, designed to pull me back, I scatter it in the name of Jesus.
I separate myself from wrong relationships.
Every wrong relationship that is causing me to dwell in sin, to fall in sin, to live in sin, I scatter you in the name of Jesus.
Let my relationships be sanctified, let my relationship be with purpose.
Every divine partner, let them be put in alignment now, that I will fulfill my destiny.
I will not miss the divine appointment.
I will not miss the divine relationship.
Every divine relationship will come to pass, every divine relationship will flourish.
Every divine partner has been restored unto me.
Father, I thank you that restoration has come.
Oh God, from this day, restoration is my portion, fullness is my portion.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Children and Family
segments: Lord Jesus, I pray for my family, I pray for my children, I pray for my seed.
Father, my family will never be found outside of your purpose, my family will never be found outside of your will.
Let my family be secure in you, Father, in the place of salvation.
Every family member that has gone astray, Father, I bring them into an encounter with you, that their souls will be saved in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may my children return unto you.
Father, give them a deep love for you, give them a deep devotion for you, give them a deep hunger for you.
Every addiction, every distraction, every bad influence, I separate it from my children.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I war for my children, and I war for my seed to come.
I destroy every agenda of the enemy, I destroy every plan of the enemy concerning my children, concerning my seed.
In the name of Jesus, Satan, you will not have my children.
Devils will not have my family.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
Every demonic power that has been influencing my family, my children, my spouse, let that demonic power be destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spirit of addiction, every spirit of affliction, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of division in my family, may it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every curse connected to my family, connected to my children, connected to my bloodline, let it break, break, break.
In the name of Jesus, I dip my family into the blood of Jesus.
All my children are in the blood of Jesus.
Their bodies, their spirits, and their souls are dipped into the blood of Jesus.
No premature death will find me or my children.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak divine protection over my family.
Wherever they go, they are protected, wherever they set foot, they are protected.
Let the fire be around my household, let the fire be around my children, let the fire be around my home in the name of Jesus.
Father, let there be divine order in my family, in my children, in everything we do.
My family is free, my children are free.
It is well with my family, it is well with my children, it is well with my seed.
Lord, let my joy be full concerning my children, concerning my family.
Thank you, Father, for the grace that flows to my seed, for the grace that flows through my children.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: To Forgive and Release Bitterness
segments: Father, thank you for your love and kindness, I thank you for blessing me with the gift of forgiveness.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I have been walking the wrong way before you.
My heart has been very distorted because of all that has been happening around me.
Forgive me, Father, for holding on to offense, forgive me for carrying people in my heart, forgive me for carrying resentment.
Father, help me to let go of all those who have offended me, of all those who have injured me.
Father, I choose to forgive.
Father, I choose to forgive.
Remove any hurt inside of me, remove the pain from within me, and reestablish me, oh Lord.
Father, cleanse my heart from every ounce of unforgiveness.
If there is bitterness you find in me, cleanse it out.
Help me to forgive those who have offended me, those who lied to me, those who betrayed me, those who turned against me.
Father, from today let forgiveness be my nature.
Father, some of them have not repented, but I forgive them.
I desire communion with you more than I desire retribution.
Any kind of demonic spirit that was holding me because of unforgiveness, because of bitterness, because of the blood of Jesus, I command it to be broken.
I break free of unforgiveness, I break out of bitterness.
Father, let every root of bitterness be uprooted from my heart.
Let forgiveness reign in my family, Lord.
Bring healing in my family, bring reconciliation in my family.
Father, the hold of that offense be broken today through the power of forgiveness.
I release everyone from my heart that I was offended by.
I release them to you, I forgive them completely.
I let go of every single bitterness, I let go of every pain.
I will not be a prisoner of that pain anymore.
Today I divorce myself from offense, create in me a clean heart, oh Lord.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Covering My Home
segments: Lord Jesus, you are my everything, and in this house, Jesus, you are the center of it.
Father, I thank you for the salvation of my home.
As for me and my house, we shall serve the Lord.
Father, I dedicate my entire household to you, Lord.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may my family be secure.
I pray the prayer of protection for me and my entire house.
May we be covered, may generations to come after me be covered in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, today my entire household, I bring under the mercy of the blood of Jesus.
Father, release me and my house.
Whatever has been unleashed against me and my house, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let that gate be closed.
In the name of Jesus, let no plan of the enemy prevail.
No demon shall hide in my house, no demon shall hide in my children.
Every spirit bringing division and separation in my house, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I cancel whatever spirit was following my household.
No premature death shall come close to my door.
All that was going to bring a funeral into my house, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
There shall be no sickness in my house.
Father, let there be no tears in my house.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I cleanse my environment today from all kinds of chaos.
No chaos in my home, no chaos in the lives of my children, no chaos in my marriage.
Father, I pray that my house will know the sustenance of God and the overflow blessing of God.
God's hand is upon my house, God's hand is upon my family.
I am divinely protected, me and my house, because of the covenant.
My family is set free, my home is set free.
Me and my house, we are preserved.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Spirit Spouses Fighting My Marriage
segments: Father, deliver me.
Deliver me, Lord Jesus.
Remember me, Lord Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself.
I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant.
Whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously, let that covenant catch fire by reason of the blood of Jesus.
I am disconnected from witchcraft, from sorcery, from occultic powers, from marine kingdoms.
That spiritual husband, that spiritual wife, whatever it is, I disconnect myself.
Every demonic spouse, I divorce myself from you.
Everything married to me, I separate myself from it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic spirit hiding in my life, I command you in the name of Jesus, who is King and Lord and God.
Come out of me, come out of my family, come out of my children.
You evil spirit, you spiritual husband that has caused barrenness, that has caused trouble, that has caused affliction, come out of me now in the name of Jesus.
I arrest you by fire, in the name of Jesus, your time is up.
Release my fruitfulness, release my children, release my life, release my purpose, release my destiny.
You will not trouble my home, you will not trouble my relationships, you will not trouble my children.
Let every spirit of witchcraft and sorcery be broken in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Take all your evil work, take all your evil deposit, release me now in the name of Jesus.
Every damage that you have caused, every issue that you have caused, take everything back and never touch my life.
Your assignment is over, your assignment is up.
I divorce you from me forever in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will never see me, you will never touch me, you will never touch my children.
You have no place inside of me, your time is done.
Every spirit fighting against my marriage that I don't even know, may that spirit be scattered today.
Father, help me and help my marriage in Jesus name.
Father, I am set free today.
From today I am free in Jesus name, and my home will be better than ever.
I belong to King Jesus, I am secured by the Holy Spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Breaking Patterns of Broken Marriages
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, every secret covenant holding my life, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Wherever there are covenants, I divorce myself from them.
Broken relationships, broken marriages, let it be finished today in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Every satanic network over my life, I break it and I pull it down.
Where there are occultic powers, where there are occultic covenants, let them be burned, let them be destroyed.
Every blood, every altar connected to me, let it be scattered where it came from, let it catch fire and be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
The powers of witchcraft and sorcery that have held me from my father's side, from my mother's side, you are arrested, you are bound.
Every altar, if my name is on it, let it catch fire.
If my children's name is on it, let it catch fire.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every diabolical covenant will be broken today.
Father, wherever the enemy has caused rifts in my family, even for generations, today I break every agenda of darkness that has caused separation.
Every spirit bringing division and separation in my house, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Every assignment of demons to cause separation and division in my home, today I neutralize your assignment, I terminate your assignment.
You spirit from the water, I destroy your connection to my family.
I divorce you from my children, I divorce you from everyone that you have connected yourself to.
I strip you of your power, you will never touch my family again.
Father, make a distinction between me and every evil spirit that is hiding in my life.
Any demonic spirit that has tormented my life, the life of my children, the life of my spouse, today I make a distinction and I separate myself in the mighty name of Jesus.
I divorce every lie of the enemy, I divorce myself from it.
Everything that denies me what God has promised me, I divorce myself from it.
I divorce myself from the past, I divorce myself from past memories.
I receive everything new that you have for me.
Father, let there begin to be a shift of hearts in my family.
Me and my family will be free.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am divorced from everything that is of the kingdom of darkness.
I belong to Jesus, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Witchcraft in My Home
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, because of the blood of Jesus, I am free.
Every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of sorcery, may it be cancelled now in the name of Jesus upon my children, upon my family, upon my future.
Spirit of witchcraft, in the mighty name of Jesus, be thou broken.
That witchcraft in my family, I destroy it in the name of Jesus.
Whosoever is releasing witchcraft against my family, against my children, against my destiny, today I terminate your assignment.
No witchcraft will prevail in my family, no witchcraft will remain in my home, no witchcraft will remain over my children.
Every witchcraft that has been behind the afflictions in my home, be arrested, be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
Every witchcraft enchantment be broken, every witchcraft spell be broken, every witchcraft decree be broken.
Father, let the blood of Jesus begin to speak over my home.
Father, wherever it started, even in generations past, let your power locate the root of that witchcraft and completely annihilate it from my family in the name of Jesus.
Every altar that was raised where demonic sacrifices were made, today I tear every altar down.
Whatsoever was done in darkness, whatsoever was agreed in secret, I expose every witchcraft against my marriage.
Every power of witchcraft, every power of sorcery, you are under my feet today in the name of Jesus.
You will not manipulate my mind, you will not manipulate my home, you will not manipulate my children in the mighty name of Jesus.
I disconnect my family, I disconnect my loved ones, I disconnect my children from every witchcraft, from every power of darkness.
Every witchcraft power that is operating from behind darkness, today I expose you, I arrest you and I break you in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every enchantment set up against me, let every plan of the enemy against me and my family, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Every evil spirit over my family, I terminate your agenda, I break you in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of sorcery, I break you off of my marriage, I break you off of my children.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from witchcraft, I am separated from sorcery.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Demons have no place around my family.
My children are free, my home is free, my loved ones are free.
Because of the blood of Jesus, my family is covered.
Because of the blood of Jesus, victory is mine, in Jesus name, amen.

title: For Restoration of My Marriage
segments: God, I want you to heal my home.
I don't know how to let go of this pain, my Father, I'm laying it down before you, Lord.
Father, I release my pain today.
I will not carry it any longer.
Father, take this from me.
Father, bring healing in my home.
Every spirit that affects my marriage, I break your hold in the name of Jesus Christ.
You will not torment my home in the mighty name of Jesus.
Lord Jesus, every agenda of the enemy happening in the background, every agenda of Satan in the dark, let it not only be uncovered, but let it be destroyed.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every enchantment against me and my family, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Whatever is trying to remove the answer of God from my marriage, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I send the word of God into my life.
May every area that is broken in my life be restored today.
Put my marriage back together, put my home back together.
Lord, let there be a completed restoration in my home.
Restore my heart, restore my joy, restore purpose.
I declare restoration in my marriage.
I declare restoration in my home.
I declare restoration in my family.
I declare restoration in every area of my life in the name of Jesus.
Restoration of the mind, restoration of the heart, restoration of the soul.
My marriage is revived.
My home is aligned with the promises of God concerning me.
Today is a new beginning in my marriage.
Today is a new beginning in my home.
Lord, thank you for restoring my marriage.
Restoration is my portion in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Love and Unity in My Marriage
segments: Father, let me know peace.
Father, as I keep my eyes on you, let me be kept in perfect peace.
Let my marriage know peace, let my family know peace, let my children know peace.
Lord, that one thing I bring before your throne of grace, my family, my home, my marriage.
Lord, turn it around on my behalf.
That one thing, I break it, I cancel it, I destroy it in the mighty name of Jesus.
May the power of witchcraft against my marriage be broken.
May every scheme of the enemy be broken.
Every plan, every trap, every witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let every spirit of witchcraft and sorcery be broken in the name of the Lord Jesus.
May your will be done for my family.
The spirit of anti-marriage be canceled, spirit of witchcraft be canceled.
Every trouble that has plagued my family, Father, from today let peace mark my family.
Every trouble be stilled, every trouble be ceased by your peace.
Let my atmosphere be peace.
Show me your favor and your goodness, show me your kindness.
My home will be better than ever.
The blessing that God has ordained for my home, no one will ever take it from me.
Your word is settled in heaven, it will be done, Father, let it be done.
Yours is the kingdom forever, your will be done, let it be done.
It is turning around for my good.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Delay in Marriage
segments: Jesus, my God and my Lord, answer my prayer.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today solve my situation.
Remember your word to me, oh God, and today solve that situation.
God, bring everything about me, my life, into alignment with your promise.
Remember me, oh God.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every spirit fighting against me that I don't even know, may that spirit be scattered today.
I scatter it in the name of Jesus, I break his power.
May the power of witchcraft be broken.
May every scheme of the enemy against my marriage be broken.
Every plan, every trap, every witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I am separated from every spirit of darkness.
Every wicked spirit that would try to lay claim upon me, I am separated now by the blood of Jesus.
I am divorced from every demon, from every agenda of every spirit.
I break his hold from me now in the name of Jesus.
Father, let every curse be broken, every misfortune be removed.
That cloud of darkness, Lord, that has caused chaos, havoc, lack and stagnancy, Father, today it ends in the name of Jesus.
Let there be a mighty turn around from today.
Because of the blessing, every curse is broken.
Because of the blessing, every agreement with the dark is broken.
Because I feel delayed in the area of marriage, I expedite it in Jesus name.
May God send me somebody.
From today, my future is bright and my doors have been opened.
I am disconnected from my past in the mighty name of Jesus Christ.
Father, fulfill your word in Jesus name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Breaking Spirit Spouse Bondage
segments: Father, deliver me.
Deliver me, Lord Jesus.
Remember me, Lord Jesus.
Father, because of the blood of Jesus, I am coming out of this cage.
Because of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from spiritual husbands, I am separated from curses.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself from every old covenant, whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously.
Let that covenant catch fire by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Let it lose its power in the name of Jesus.
I am disconnected from witchcraft, from sorcery, from occultic powers, from marine kingdoms.
That spiritual husband, that spiritual wife, whatever it is, I disconnect myself.
Every demonic spirit hiding in my life, I command you in the name of Jesus, who is King and Lord and God, come out of me.
You evil spirit, you spiritual husband that has caused barrenness, that has caused trouble, that has caused affliction, come out of me now in the name of Jesus.
You unclean spirit, spiritual wife, in the mighty name of Jesus, your time in me has expired.
In the name of Jesus, your time is up.
Release my fruitfulness, release my life, release my purpose, release my destiny.
Everything you have tied, everything you have tried to destroy, I chain you today, I bind you today, and I command you go back to the pit.
You will not trouble my home, you will not trouble my relationships, you will not trouble my children.
Take every evil deposit that you put in me and release me now in the name of Jesus.
Your assignment is over.
I divorce you from me forever in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, because of the blood of Jesus, let everything that I was fed by evil be flushed out in the name of Jesus.
Whatever was holding me back, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I revoke it, by reason of the blood of Jesus, I erase it.
In the name of Jesus, I belong to King Jesus.
I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon.
From today I rest in Jesus name, it is finished.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Breaking Ungodly Soul Ties
segments: Father, today I give my life to you.
Father, I renounce where my feet stepped in that I was not supposed to be.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
Whatever connection I have with darkness unknowingly, let it be broken now.
May every wicked relationship be scattered in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every wicked relationship designed to delay my life, designed to confuse my life, designed to empty me, designed to pull me back, I scatter it in the name of Jesus.
Father, I separate myself from wrong relationships.
Every relationship in my life that is derailing the purpose of God, I scatter it in the name of Jesus.
Every wrong relationship that is causing me to dwell in sin, to fall in sin, to live in sin, I scatter you in the name of Jesus.
That spiritual husband, that spiritual wife, whatever it is, I disconnect myself.
You wicked spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus, I disconnect you from my soul.
I disconnect you from my spirit, I disconnect you from everything that has to do with me.
Wherever there are covenants, I divorce myself from them.
Where I have been tied for ages, for years, let it be finished today in the name of the Lord Jesus.
I disconnect myself from every chain of the past that has followed me into the present.
I break every attachment of evil, I break every satanic connection, I break every occultic connection.
I break every attachment of the past, I break every link from the past in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every link and every chain, Father, I disconnect in the name of Jesus.
Let even my relationships be sanctified.
I will not be drawn into darkness.
I declare freedom over my life by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Freedom comes today, freedom comes now.
I belong to King Jesus, I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am disconnected, I am disconnected.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Have Been Betrayed
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the strength, oh God.
Give me the strength to forgive all those that have hurt me.
Give me the strength to forgive all those that have betrayed me, to forgive all those that have abandoned me.
Wherever I have experienced trauma, wherever I have experienced pain, help me to forgive.
All those who have betrayed me, God, I release them now.
God, I lay this pain at your feet, God, I lay this hurt at your feet.
I break from bitterness, I break free of unforgiveness, I break out of bitterness.
Father, let my heart be set free, let my heart be made free.
Help me to forgive as you have forgiven me.
Father, where it is hard to forgive, I depend on your grace.
Father, show me the vision beyond the betrayal, show me the vision beyond that heartache.
I will see past the hurt, I will see past the betrayal, I will see past the pain.
Father, let every root of bitterness be uprooted from my heart.
Cause me to recognize, God, that where they hurt me, you were just stretching me.
When they betrayed me, God, you were purifying me.
Every betrayal, I am free from it, God.
Every backstabbing, I am free from it, God.
Every wound, I am healed from it today.
I will not be disqualified any longer, not because of that betrayal, not because of that broken heart.
Father, let my heart be free, my heart be focused, my vision be steady.
May my eyes be opened, may my discernment be activated, that I will know who is for me and who is against me.
May I never be betrayed by a kiss.
Let the prophetic word that is declared over my life by you be fulfilled in my life.
God, my trust is in you, in Jesus name, Amen.

title: Against Household Enemies
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for this hour.
Today I understand that you have anointed me to destroy the foundations of the enemy.
Every single thing that Satan did in my family, his desire was to continue the pattern in my children.
Because of the anointing, let every wrong be corrected.
Every evil spirit with an intention against my family, I cancel you in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of wickedness that has tried to infiltrate my family, infiltrate my home, I command, catch fire now.
Every evil spirit that will try to divide my household, catch fire in the name of Jesus.
I sever your connection, I sever my agreement with you, I break you now.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I draw a line around my family.
You cannot enter!
Every demonic power that has been influencing my family, my children, my spouse, let that demonic power be destroyed.
Every spirit of addiction, every spirit of affliction, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of division in my family, may it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every attack of the enemy that is coming against me and my family, I abort and nullify.
Every plan of the enemy against my family, I abort in the mighty name of Jesus.
That witchcraft in my family, I destroy it in the name of Jesus.
No witchcraft will prevail in my family.
No witchcraft will remain in my home, no witchcraft will remain over my children.
Today I stop every demonic agent in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every assignment that will come against my household, I scatter in the mighty name of Jesus.
I remove you from everything that has to do with me.
You demon behind the issues in my family, come out in the name of Jesus.
Father, I apply the blood over my life, over my household.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic attack is rendered powerless.
The angels of God are activated in my life, they are activated in my family.
I am secure in Jesus Christ.
I become freedom for my children, I become freedom for my household.
In the name of Jesus, I am free, Amen.

title: For My Children's Destiny
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my family is useful to you.
Father, I give my children to you.
Father, use my children, Father, use my seed, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Your name will be glorified through my children, your name will be glorified through my seed.
Father, make them carriers of your virtue, make them carriers of your word, make them carriers of your spirit.
Those that are born, my children unborn, and even the children to come, Father, use them for your glory.
Use them for your divine purpose, Father, establish your kingdom through their life.
Father, my children are yours.
My sons, my daughters shall be the instruments of heaven in their generation.
God, may my children produce after your kind, may my family reflect your kind.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may my children return unto you.
Give them a deep love for you, give them a deep devotion for you, give them a deep hunger for you.
Every addiction that has tried to rise, every distraction, every bad influence, I separate it from my children.
Make my children men and women of fire, make my children men and women of the presence of God.
In the name of Jesus, Satan, you will not have my children.
Every power of darkness targeting my children, you will not have them in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, I command you reverse back to sender.
Every plan of demonic patterns to be established in my bloodline, today I arrest you in the name of Jesus.
Every curse that has come down the bloodline pursuing the life of my children, today I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
No assignment to cut the lives of my children short will succeed today.
I wield my sonship authority to execute judgment against anything that opposes your will for my children.
My children will not be held by any curse.
My seed will not be bound by any curse.
My children are covered, my children are secured by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Father, I thank you for my children, in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Protection over My Children
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, divine protection for my family, divine protection for my children.
In the name of Jesus, I dip my family into the blood of Jesus.
All my children are in the blood of Jesus.
Today I dip all my children in the blood of Jesus, their bodies, their spirits, and their souls.
No premature death will find me or my children.
In the name of Jesus, Satan, you will not have my children.
Devils will not have my family.
Every assignment of demons, every power of darkness targeting my children, you will not have them in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, I command you reverse back to sender.
Every plan of satanic destruction, every plan of demonic patterns to be established in my bloodline, I arrest you in the name of Jesus.
I declare you will not see that son, you will not see that daughter, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, everyone that is coming from me to generations after, I secure them now in the name of Jesus.
My children are covered, my children are secured.
I establish a law of protection over my family, that calamities will not befall my family.
Father, arrows that are intended for people will not catch them by mistake.
Wherever they go, they are protected, wherever they set foot, they are protected.
No accidents, no evil in the name of Jesus.
Father, you will keep my children from the arrow that flies by day.
There is no claim over my life, no claim over my children, no claim over my bloodline.
I have life, my children shall live.
Father, protect their days, protect their lives.
Their lives are preserved, they will never ever be cut short in Jesus name.
Father, I thank you for preservation, I thank you for preservation.
Thank you, Father, thank you for your protection, Lord, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Wayward Child
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, may my children return unto you.
Father, give them a deep love for you, give them a deep devotion for you, give them a deep hunger for you.
That son, that daughter, Father, let that seed in their spirit begin to draw them back, back to the presence of God, back to the house of the Lord.
Father, I redirect their affection, I redirect their attention, I redirect their devotion.
I redirect their love, I redirect their focus, Father.
Father, I give them a heart of flesh.
Every addiction that has tried to rise, every distraction, every bad influence, I separate it from my children.
Every wicked spirit attacking my children, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
Wherever confusion has entered into the minds of my children, let it be uprooted now.
Whatever seed of darkness has been planted into my children, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
You wicked spirits, I command you now in the name of Jesus, come out from their hearts, come out from their minds.
Let their minds be released from the spirit of confusion, and let clarity come.
I disconnect my sons, my daughters from every work of darkness in the name of Jesus.
You evil spirit, you will no longer steal children from this family.
Father, let your Spirit arise in my children, let faith arise in my children.
Let their identity be rooted in Christ.
Everyone in my family shall be born again in the name of Jesus.
My sons, my daughters shall be the instruments of heaven in their generation.
My sons and my daughters from the north, the south, the east, and the west, wherever they are, Father, I call my children back to you.
I call them back to your house, I call them back to your home, I call them back to your temple, Father.
I draw my children back, I call my children back.
I decree and declare that my children will walk in alignment with the word.
My children shall live and not die.
May my children return back to you, Lord, in Jesus name, Amen.

title: Breaking Curses off My Children
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, every curse that has been declared over my life, over my children, over my home, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse over my family be broken, every curse over my children be broken.
Every carryover curse from my fathers to my father's fathers, up to the fourth generation, I break it today.
Every curse that has come down the bloodline pursuing the life of my children, today I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse spoken over my bloodline, break, every curse pronounced over my name, break in the name of Jesus.
Every word that was spoken to release the curse, break in the name of Jesus.
Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was entered into on the behalf of my bloodline, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.
No curse will stand over my children, no curse will operate in my bloodline.
My children's head will not hold any curse.
Every curse that has afflicted my children, wherever that curse was released, I break you today.
Every pattern of premature death, every pattern of untimely death, I cancel it now.
It will not touch me, it will not touch my children, it will not touch my bloodline.
A new pattern has been established from today for my children, for my family, for my home.
Father, I redeem my children from every curse, I redeem my grandkids from every curse.
Every curse was nailed to your cross, so I strip every legality by reason of the blood of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, generational curses are broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, no curse shall be perpetuated.
I become freedom for my children, I become freedom for my household, I become freedom for my bloodline.
As you set me free, Father, freedom shall go from me to my children, to my children's children.
Father, I draw the bloodline, a new beginning, free of curse, that the blessing of God will abound in my life, in my children, in my home.
Father, let your blessing rest on my family in the name of Jesus.
No curse will speak over my children.
Every curse is destroyed, every curse is neutralized, every curse is broken.
Father, I thank you, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Dedicating My Children to God
segments: Father, I give you my children.
Lord, today I genuinely give my child to you, as Samuel's mother gave up Samuel.
I am giving up my children to you.
Watch over them, lead them, guide them, that everything to do with their life, Lord, be centered by you.
Lord, I have given their life to you, because you gave them to me, I give them to you.
Father, use my children, Father, use my seed, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, my children belong to you.
My children are yours, my children are yours.
I offer them to you as a living sacrifice, Father.
Your name will be glorified through my children, your name will be glorified through my seed.
Father, make them carriers of your virtue, make them carriers of your word, make them carriers of your spirit.
Lord, today as I present my children before you, may they never be able to escape your presence.
When they err you will bring them back, when they lose their way you will send your angels to guide them back.
May they forever stand in your presence, may they forever be secure, may they forever be preserved.
Father, rescue them, secure them, hide their lives in Christ and in you.
May your covenant be with them, may your covering be with them.
Father, as I give my children to you, may no work of the enemy ever touch them.
Whatever intention of Satan to shorten their life, to destroy their life, to disrupt their life, may it never come to pass in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I declare long life, I declare long life, prosperity, divine protection over my children.
Premature death will never be their portion.
There will be no generational curses or patterns upon my children.
Father, give me the wisdom and the understanding to be able to raise my children in a way that is pleasing unto you.
May they always know how to hear your voice and always know how to return to you, Lord.
Lord, as I touch them, they are secure, they are protected, they will fulfill their destinies.
Father, I thank you that you have done it and your word is fulfilled in their lives in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Parents
segments: My father, my father, in the name of Jesus.
Father, today I rely on you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, in the powerful name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, may that chain be broken.
The chain that was upon my mother, the chain that was upon my father, in the mighty name of Jesus, break.
Wherever you tied my mother, wherever you tied my father, in the name of Jesus, break today.
Your power is broken from today, your hold is destroyed from today, your influence is neutralized from today.
Any chain that held my family, no more.
The chain of sin, the chain of iniquity, be broken from my parents in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let every agent of the devil sent against my family be scattered.
May every agent of the devil sent against my father and my mother be scattered.
My father, my maker, any altar raised against my family, raised against my life, from today it shall be broken.
Every wicked altar, every wicked enchantment, wherever you are located, catch fire of the Holy Ghost.
If that strong man was in the time of my father, I arrest the strong man, him and his host.
I cast them into the pit in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spiritual contention in the lives of my parents, every spiritual challenge in their lives, in the name of Jesus, I silence those demons.
I silence those spirits, I silence those challenges in the name of Jesus.
From my father's side, my mother's side, every blessing that was stolen, every blessing that was taken, Father, I take it back.
Whatever was taken from my fathers, may it be restored now in the mighty name of Jesus.
May my joy be full when I see the doors of my parents open in the name of Jesus.
Let there be overflowing joy now in the name of Jesus.
Father, my parents are free from every chain.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Poverty and Financial Lack
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your grace.
I thank you that all that I desire and all that I need, Lord, you have made provision available for my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, cleanse my heart today, purify my heart today.
Deliver me from financial attachments.
Father, remove unbelief from my heart.
Everything assigned to destroy my finances, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be scattered and let it be destroyed.
Every assignment of dryness, every assignment of struggle, every assignment of poverty, be arrested in the name of Jesus.
Patterns of poverty, patterns of limitation, patterns of difficulty, let every evil pattern be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I break the power of debt over my life.
I will not serve mammon.
Money will serve me as I serve you.
Father, I break every chain of debt, I break it by fire.
I break the chains of working like an elephant and reaping like an ant.
I break every chain of hard labor without results.
I seal every hole that has been draining my finances.
In the mighty name of Jesus, may my finances be activated, may my life flourish again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my capacity to manage wealth.
A poverty mentality, a paycheck to paycheck mentality, Father, in the name of Jesus, today I remove that mindset.
My days of poverty have expired, my days of struggle have expired.
Lack is a thing of the past, poverty is a thing of the past, from today in the name of Jesus.
I declare myself completely liberated from debt.
I shall never borrow, I will be a lender, I will be a giver.
Debt is not my portion, I am delivered from debt.
My basket will never be empty, my well will never run dry.
Poverty is no longer my portion, lack is not my portion.
The blessing of the Lord rests upon everything I touch.
Lord, I will always have more than enough because you have said it to be so.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Prosperity in My Work and Business
segments: Father, I thank you that prosperity comes from you, increase comes from you.
Whatever you will ever give me, wealth of all kinds, be assured, Lord, it is already yours.
I am simply going to use it as you want.
Father, help me not to forget, let me not be like the children of Israel that when you prosper me, I forget you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today I receive the ability to make wealth, I receive power to make wealth.
Increase my capacity to receive every single bit of increase that you have.
That demon that has been holding my breakthroughs, that demon that has been stealing my jobs and opportunities, the fire of the Holy Spirit shall destroy them.
In the mighty name of Jesus, today I break the iron bolt.
Whatever I touch will prosper, nothing will contend with what God has put in my hands.
Father, I wage war with my hands against every poverty, whatsoever has been a limitation for my family.
I break and I reverse every handwriting of poverty, of fruitless effort in my life.
I prophesy that all my labor shall never be in vain.
