As Elijah commanded rain to fall, I command rain to fall on my business, on the work of my hands.
Father, today may the windows of heaven be open over me.
Open up the windows of heaven over my business, over my career, over my job, over the works of my hands.
Father, in the work and the labor you have given me to do, I will see result, I will see increase, I will see expansion.
Father, let there be manifestations, that contracts will begin to come, that connections will begin to come.
Whatsoever I shall lay my hands on, whatever I will venture out to do, it shall succeed in the name of Jesus.
There will be a quickening in everything that I do.
I receive the oil to prosper, I receive the unction to increase.
I decree and declare that every business that you have given me produces solutions and is successful throughout the earth.
I decree clients and customers coming from the north, the south, the east, and the west.
I command favor in the marketplace, in the city and in the countryside.
My business will prosper, my career will prosper.
I will prosper in my business, I will prosper in my job, in my career, I will prosper in my finances.
From this hour, everything I touch will prosper, prosperity is my portion.
My Lord and my God, I thank you for wisdom that will maintain prosperity.
Father, I thank you that it is done, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Open Doors and Opportunities
segments: Father, I thank you in the name of your son Jesus for your grace and your mercy.
Thank you for opening doors that no man can open.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every door in my life, may it be open now.
I speak to every door, I remove every gatekeeper.
I remove every gatekeeper that is contending with my career.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every iron gate, every bronze door standing in my way, let that gate be broken.
Everything that is holding me behind, that spirit that has put limitation on me, let that work be broken.
You stubborn gates, today in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I shatter you into pieces.
Whatever my hand touches shall not be delayed, it shall not be denied.
Those who held the opportunities God gave to me, I command them now to deliver it unto me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I take back every opportunity, I take back every opportunity, in the name of Jesus.
Today I open doors that were shut.
Today I reactivate opportunities that were lost.
Every door that was shut against my opportunities, every door that was shut against my promotion, every door that was shut against my advancement, Father, I open those doors.
Every resistance and opposition, give way by the decree of the Lord.
Father, I open doors in my life, I open opportunities in my life now.
I open doors of prosperity, I open doors of wealth into my life.
Open doors for my business, open doors for my career.
Father, from today I will not miss my opportunities.
I will not miss the doors that you open before me.
I thank you for your angels going ahead of me that are opening doors in the mighty name of Jesus.
Doors of opportunity, doors of increase, in the name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, I receive my open doors, I receive my elevation.
Doors are opening for me in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Divine Favor
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor, I thank you for grace, and I thank you for mercy.
Father, I thank you for your love and mercy.
Through your favor and grace, you have found me, blessed me, anointed me, and appointed me in places where I am not qualified to stand.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the capacity to carry favor.
Give me the capacity to face everything that comes with favor.
Father, cleanse my heart, Father, purify my heart.
Father, give me the grace to sustain the atmosphere of favor.
Anything that wants to contaminate this atmosphere, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I clothe myself with divine favor.
Not just favor, divine favor.
In every negotiation, whatever I say, it shall be favored, for God has favored me.
I receive favor for expansion.
I receive uncommon favor today, I receive uncommon access today, I receive uncommon keys today.
Favor marks my business, favor marks my career, favor marks my finances.
Wherever there was struggle and resistance, it gives way.
I was ignored in the past, I was overlooked in the past, I was undermined in the past.
My era of favor has come.
Favor in those opportunities, favor in that career, favor with man and with God.
I thank you that favor precedes me, that it goes into rooms that I have not arrived in yet, that it hunts down opportunities I have not even put my name in for.
What my efforts cannot produce for me, the favor of God will produce for me.
I am favored to own homes, I am favored to own businesses, I am favored for increase.
I am favored by God, I am favored by man.
I am not favored because of who is around me, I am favored because you made me to be.
Everything about me is favor, I overflow with your favor.
Favor is my portion in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Give to God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for what you have given unto me.
Father, thank you, what you have given me is more than I could ever give to you.
Lord Jesus, I honor you with my giving.
I express my love with my giving from today, oh Lord.
Everything I put in your hands, I am just returning what you gave me.
No one can buy a blessing from you, but I can be obedient with my sacrifice to you.
Lord, today as I give, heighten my spirit.
Let my sacrifice speak for me.
Father, I join my prayer with this sacrifice.
Father, cleanse my heart, let my sacrifice before you be a sign of humility and a sign of love.
Anything that is of the devil in my walk with you, let it be removed in the name of Jesus.
May my seed always speak for me, may it stand as a memorial before you.
Where I cannot speak, let my offering speak, let my sacrifice speak.
Father, remember my seed today.
Remember every toil that I have done in your kingdom.
Every seed that the fowls devoured, every harvest that was destroyed, Father, I say no more.
My harvest will be destroyed no more.
As I give unto your work, expand my borders, expand my territory.
For your name's sake, increase me and prosper me.
Let my giving become a net that will catch many souls and bring them unto your kingdom.
May the devourer be far from what you have given me.
As I give to you, I will never lack, because there are no losses in you.
There is only increase in Jesus name.
I know that you have already increased me, I know that you have multiplied me.
Anything in your hands is not left empty, but it is multiplied in the name of Jesus.
I am fruitful in the mighty name of Jesus.
Receive my sacrifice today, receive my offering, and may your name be glorified.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For Success in Studies and Exams
segments: Father, in the name of your son Jesus, I thank you for your goodness.
Father, I need your wisdom, I need the spirit of revelation in order to acquire your knowledge.
Of my own self I can do nothing, but because of you I can do all things through your son Jesus.
Father, give me a teachable spirit.
Make me a student again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I pray that you will give me the keys to allow me to understand.
Give me the spirit of understanding as I study and read.
Father, work with me beyond my mental capacity.
Father, your word says your spirit will teach me all things.
Father, I pray that your Holy Spirit will work in me that I will become all you have destined for me to be.
Father, increase my discernment.
I receive grace for my focus.
I am not good at managing my time, I need your help, God.
Where I am weak, be my strength.
Father, in that weakness, I receive your strength.
Father, today I have learned, help me to apply it.
Give me the grace by your Holy Spirit to carry out what I have learned.
Father, may I remain in what I have learned.
May it be a place I stand in, may it be a place I walk in.
Lead my footsteps, direct my path, that I may arrive where you want me to go.
Lord, go with me.
Father, may your grace travel with me in every endeavor that I will ever have.
Father, may your grace work for me.
Father, I want to go beyond where I am.
Thank you for increasing me and making me better in your presence.
What I have learned has matured me, has changed me, has transformed me.
Glorify yourself now and eternally in the name of your only son Jesus Christ. Amen.

title: Breaking Generational Poverty
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my capacity to manage wealth.
Father, in the name of Jesus, the poverty mentality, the struggling mentality, the paycheck to paycheck mentality that was passed on to me, today I remove that mindset.
Every mindset of poverty, be removed in the mighty name of Jesus.
I will not struggle with what my father struggled with.
I will not struggle with what my mother struggled with.
Father, I will not repeat the mistakes of my parents.
I will not repeat the patterns of poverty that they lived.
That spirit that held my family, by the Spirit of God, I rebuke it, I bind it.
Those situations that held my family, I rebuke it now.
Those situations that held my career, I rebuke it now in the name of Jesus.
Patterns of poverty, patterns of lack, patterns of starting and never finishing, patterns of almost there but never there, in the name of Jesus, I disconnect myself.
I loose myself from every cycle and every pattern that is generated from the bloodline.
I will not conform to any pattern of trouble, any pattern of poverty.
Every negative pattern that followed my father, that followed my mother, that followed my grandfather, that followed my grandmother, Father, I break out of evil patterns.
Father, do a new thing with me.
Establish something new for the generations to come after me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from generational curses.
Every generational poverty, every generational struggle is no longer mine.
I remove it from my life.
And I am living in a different future, the future Jesus Christ ordained for me.
My days of poverty have expired.
My days of struggle have expired.
The days of living paycheck to paycheck are gone.
Father, your blessing is here, may it rest upon me, may it rest upon my family.
That blessing will be received from generation to generation today.
May my family never know poverty because of what you are doing with me.
Poverty is a thing of the past, struggle is a thing of the past.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Cancelling Words I Spoke over My Finances
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I switch directions.
I cancel every word that I have spoken over my finances.
Every negative word, I cancel it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I cancel every negative word I have spoken.
Words I spoke as a child, words I have spoken as an adult, words I have spoken in pain, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Father, every idle word that I spoke out of woundedness, out of unforgiveness, out of anger, out of disappointment, I cancel it now in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I cancel every word that I spoke of lack or defeat or poverty or stagnation.
Wherever my woundedness spoke, I cancel it.
Wherever fear spoke, I cancel it.
Wherever disappointment was speaking, I cancel it.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life.
Words of failure, words of complaining, that have created an atmosphere of demons, I undo those words.
I reverse those words and I make those words of no effect.
Every word of delay, I cancel it.
Every word of failure, I cancel it.
Every word of lack, I cancel it.
Every negative word that I have spoken concerning myself, I break it and tear it down in the mighty name of Jesus.
My truth is the truth that God has spoken over my life.
Father, reverse every negative word from me.
Every word of failure, may it lose its power because of the blood of Jesus.
Father, you have already said yes to my finances.
I decree and declare right now in the name of Jesus that this is a new beginning.
This is a new beginning of prosperity, a new beginning of success.
I stand in the place that it is so and that I am prosperous.
I decree that today contracts will come and clients will come.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I receive the oil of prosperity.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Evil Altars over My Finances
segments: Father, in the name of your holy son Jesus Christ, I stand my ground against every evil spiritual power, sorcery, witchcraft, hidden altars and blood covenants that have been set up against me and my family.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I pull down every altar, every known altar, every unknown altar.
Whatever its name, wherever its beginning, if it does not come from you, today I tear it down.
Every altar that has been ruling in my family, every altar that is from generations past, every altar that I have serviced knowingly or unknowingly, I tear that altar down.
No altar shall rule my businesses, no altar will rule my destiny.
Every place that my finances have been sought after, every place that my businesses have been sought after, Father, today I break every evil transaction.
I destroy every satanic transaction happening on a demonic altar.
Wherever it is, in the water, in the mountain, I command it to break in the name of Jesus.
I nullify every evil transaction by reason of the blood of Jesus.
I dry up that altar in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic altar in my family that has caused me to be useless in life, let that altar be destroyed today.
Let that altar be consumed by fire today, that altar that has been fighting me not to get to my portion.
May the angel of the Lord pursue that altar, let him draw out his sword, let him destroy that altar.
My life must be free, I must receive my portion.
Every demonic altar that sacrificed me, every evil connection in my life, today be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every link that has connected me to a demonic altar where my name has been summoned, I break that link.
Wherever my name is called, let the fire of God appear.
I scatter that altar, I dismantle it completely from today in the mighty name of Jesus.
Over every curse, over every altar, over every demonic force, be thou broken in the name of Jesus.
By that holy blood, my ground has been secured.
Curses are broken, prosperity is mine.
I release acceleration, I release speed over my finances, over my career, over my destiny.
I declare restoration in my finances.
I declare restoration in my career, I declare restoration in my business.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Witchcraft over My Finances
segments: Father, I thank you, for you have commanded the blessing upon me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whosoever has done rituals against me in order to destroy my life and my future, let every spirit of witchcraft catch fire.
That witchcraft in my family, I destroy it in the name of Jesus.
Every poverty, every stagnancy, every limitation in my family that is linked to witchcraft, today I destroy that witchcraft in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every witchcraft enchantment be broken.
Every witchcraft incantation be broken.
Every witchcraft spell be broken.
Every witchcraft decree be broken.
Wherever you are hiding, by the light of God, I expose you.
Father, let your power locate the root of that witchcraft and completely annihilate it from my family in the name of Jesus.
I draw the bloodline against every power of witchcraft by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Every altar that was raised where my name was called, today I tear every altar down.
That chain that has held my finances, let it be broken.
That witchcraft, that sorcery that has held me, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Spirit of poverty, spirit of dryness, the spirit that has been taking finances from me, I command you to leave me.
Every spirit of witchcraft, I scatter you now from my home.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I break your hold and I break your influence.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I overcome poverty.
I overcome debt.
No more will I suffer setbacks, no more will I suffer struggle.
Every satanic influence that was operating even through debt, through curses, through bondage, today it is broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, you have given me dominion and possession over my finances.
Let every evil thing done against me and my family be destroyed now in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am above witchcraft in Jesus name.
I receive a new dimension of wealth, a new dimension of increase.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against the Devourer and Wasters
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus.
Because of your blood I am redeemed, and redemption is my portion.
I thank you that I am under the blessing, the blessing of multiplication, the blessing of increase.
Whatever spirit is coming against my prosperity, in the name of Jesus I remove it, I silence it, I abort it.
Whatever medium is coming against me, I decree and I declare, I abort your plans in the mighty name of Jesus.
Break every hole in my finances, break every hole.
Close every access point in the name of Jesus.
I declare freedom from every loss and every waste that the spirits have caused in my family.
Every declaration that has been made on altars that are not of God over my finances, it is broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every form of limitation is cancelled in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every excuse in my life, the reasons why there is poverty, the reasons why there is hardship, be broken in Jesus name.
Let every error in my finances be corrected.
The error of struggle, the error of poverty, the error of backwardness, let it be corrected now in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today I arrest the plan of the enemy in the mighty name of Jesus.
Remove the evil scent from me, so that things in my life may move forward for your glory.
Every area of my life has been recovered of you and has been recovered by you.
From today, oh Lord, my finances are made whole.
No more lack, no more struggle, no more penury, no more hard labor.
From today, everything I touch will multiply.
Everything I touch will increase in the name of Jesus.
It is well with my business, it is well with all that concerns me.
From today I will live a life of abundance.
Father, multiply me in every good thing unto your own glory.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Freedom from Debt
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, these bills have been a chain upon my life.
But by reason of the blood of Jesus, today this chain shall be broken.
Father, you are able to take care of my bills and my daily needs.
Today I break the power of debt over my life.
I declare that you are the only one who will rule over me, not my boss, not the superiors of the land, but you, oh Lord.
I will not serve mammon, mammon will serve me as I serve you.
Whatever is leading me to debt, whatever is leading me to borrow, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of bondage, everything that has bound my life and has put me in the place of debt, may that chain be broken.
Father, I break every chain of debt, I break every chain of debt.
Whatever has hung on my neck as a weight, that chain today, I break it by fire.
I break the chains of financial struggle, I break the chains of penury.
I break the chains of working like an elephant and reaping like an ant.
Father, every paycheck is always going towards debt, every increase is always going towards debt, today it ends.
Father, I break the chains of debt, inherited debt, generational debt, ancestral debt, wherever they came from.
Father, today may every debt in my life receive provision to erase it, whether it is natural or whether it is supernatural.
May that debt be cancelled, may that stubborn mortgage be cancelled, may that car note be cancelled, may that rent be cancelled.
Every debt that has been presented before you, let it be paid off now in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, you called me not to owe anyone anything, you called me to be free.
The borrower is slave to the lender, I break that hold now in the name of Jesus.
Father, you have given me power to trample over serpents and scorpions and every power of the enemy.
Today I trample over debt, I trample over this debt in the name of Jesus.
The devil will not use any debt to keep me stagnant, the devil will not use any debt to keep me in limitation.
From today I am above debt, I am above poverty, I am above financial difficulty.
I declare myself completely liberated from debt.
I am entering into financial rest in the mighty name of Jesus.
I shall never borrow, I will be a lender, I will be a giver, me and my house.
Father, every debt is removed from me, from my children, from my family, and I receive the power to make wealth.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Daily Provision
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your grace and your mercy.
I thank you that I am your child, I thank you that you have the best for me.
I thank you that you are my provider, and you provide for me unconditionally because you simply love me.
My provision and sustenance comes from you, not from my job, not from my career.
All these things come from you.
Lord, you have made provision available for me, you have made all good things available for me.
Father, I ought not to walk in the realm of struggle.
Your word said I should not worry about what I am going to eat, I should not worry about what I am going to wear, because you will provide for all my needs.
So, Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes are set on you, my burdens are given to you.
My need is not a curse, it is simply prophetic memory of what you have already provided.
So Father, I receive what you have provided for me.
Today, oh Lord, open the storehouse on my behalf.
Oh Father, in the name of Jesus, open the storehouse of heaven for your child.
Let the season of lack in my life end, let the season of struggle in my life end.
Let the season of asking and begging end in my life, let the season of borrowing in my life end.
Every plan of the enemy that has enslaved me to this reality, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, the provision that you have ordained for me, I receive it in the name of Jesus.
Father, the blessing that you have set for me, I receive it in the name of Jesus.
I receive the finances for my home.
I receive peace, I receive provision, I receive strength, I receive stability.
Whatsoever has to do with me must increase in the name of Jesus.
Father, let this month be the month of manna, the month of heavenly provision.
Father, I pray for wisdom and understanding, that I may manage that which you have released for me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that the storehouse has been opened.
Today I receive my inheritance, as your child, oh God, I receive all that you have for me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Overflow and Abundance
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that the storehouse has been opened.
Today, oh Lord, the floodgates of heaven open, that blessings will come down in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my capacity to manage wealth.
Father, you cannot bless me if I am not a good steward.
Today I remove that mindset, a poverty mentality, a struggling mentality, a paycheck to paycheck mentality.
Remove every poverty mindset from me, remove every mindset of penury, and give me the mindset of abundance.
Father, you have broken the yoke of poverty, you have broken the yoke of struggle.
Let poverty be a thing of the past, let debt be a thing of the past, let financial struggle be a thing of the past.
My days of poverty have expired, my days of struggle have expired.
The days of just making it are gone, the days of living paycheck to paycheck are gone.
Father, I go from survival to thriving, I go from survival to abundance.
I will no longer be barely making it, but I step into the place of the overflow.
Financial overflow, financial overflow, financial overflow.
Wherever my finances were dry, my finances begin to flow, my finances begin to increase, my finances begin to multiply in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today, I receive the ability to make wealth, I receive power to make wealth.
Everything I touch from today, I will know prosperity, I will know increase.
Whatsoever I lay my hands on, let it not only prosper, let it also multiply.
God, increase me in capacity, increase me in wisdom, increase me in every way.
I receive wealth, I receive riches.
I understand that wealth is my portion, I understand that increase is my portion.
The blessing of God is my portion, spiritual and material.
Father, your blessing is here, may it rest upon me, may it rest upon my family.
It will cause me to have increase, it will cause me to have abundance, it will cause me to prosper in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I establish a new pattern of wealth, I establish a new pattern of abundance.
I shall not lack after today.
Father, the overflow will be my portion in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Am Looking for a Job
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I stand as an intercessor concerning my job.
My father and my God, position me for breakthrough.
Lord, what you have ordained for me, let it come to pass now.
Father, every year that was wasted by shut doors, today I recover every lost time.
Opportunities that were wasted, access that was wasted, whatever was lost is recovered.
Father, as I recover time, I recover access, I recover my position, I recover my blessing.
Employment ties that are demonic, by the blood of Jesus, let them be dissolved, let them be cancelled.
Everything that has been a delay in my career, I cancel it.
Everything that stands ahead of me and is causing delay, I remove in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every door in my life, may it be open now.
That job, that opportunity, let every door be open now.
I speak to every door, and I remove every gatekeeper.
I remove every gatekeeper that is contending with my career.
Let grace and favor precede me, that they will go into rooms before I arrive.
I thank you for your angels going ahead of me that are opening doors in the mighty name of Jesus.
The door you open, no man can shut, and the door you shut, no man can open.
Father, I thank you for your favor and your grace.
Today I receive favor from man, and I receive favor from God.
I speak acceleration in my life, in my career.
Thank you Lord for that new job.
Thank you Lord for that career and for the acceleration in that career.
In the mighty name of Jesus, doors are opening for me.
From today my life is changing, from today my life is shifting.
Going forward I will go into that job place, and it is well.
My endeavors will be blessed in the mighty name of Jesus.
It is well with my career, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For Promotion and Elevation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, lift me up today for your name's sake.
Lord, you desire to lift me, but you cannot lift me when I am proud.
Today I come out of pride, and I humble myself.
I submit myself under your mighty hand, that you would lift me up.
Everything that has been a delay in my career, I cancel it.
Everything that stands ahead of me and is causing delay, I remove in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every weight that would hinder my elevation is broken, every weight is removed, every weight is lifted.
Everything that kept me back, everything that kept me down, everything that was a limitation, Father, I thank you for elevation.
I decree and I declare promotion in my job, promotion in my career.
I receive my promotion, I receive my increase now.
My promotion is now, my increase is now.
My doors of promotion are open, and I receive that approval.
Father, I receive elevation in my career, in my business, in my finances.
My job and my finances begin to prosper as you cause me to elevate.
Father, my time of elevation has come, my hour of elevation is now.
I will not faint when it is time to be elevated.
Father, I will push in my elevation, I will push in my promotion.
Father, give me the strength to keep my peace as you elevate me, as you promote me.
As you elevate me, O Lord, give me grace towards those who don't like me.
I thank you for favor with my career.
As you favored them, so have you also favored me.
Father, I thank you for every opportunity to be elevated.
As I work, I will see expansion, I will see promotion, I will see elevation, I will see increase.
Elevation is for me, elevation is my portion.
From this day forth my life will never be the same again.
It is for your glory alone, and I thank you for my elevation in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Attacks at My Workplace
segments: Father, I apply the blood over my life, over my household, over my workplace.
By the blood of Jesus, I cancel every attack of the enemy against my life, against my workplace, against my destiny.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic attack is rendered powerless.
I declare that no weapon fashioned against me shall prosper.
Father, in the name of Jesus, save me from every trap of the enemy.
From this day forward, I curse every plan of the enemy.
Father, from this day forward, may I never fall victim to the plans of the enemy.
Father, give me vision to see what the enemy is planning.
God, open my eyes and give me discernment to identify when the enemy has put on a costume to deceive me.
You spirit of confusion, you spirit of distraction, you spirit of continual troubles, I cancel you in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every chain of trouble, every chain of limitation in my work, break in the name of Jesus.
Every wicked taskmaster, today I break your power in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will no longer reign in my work, you will no longer reign in my finances.
Every iron gate, every bronze door standing in my way, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
That spirit that has put limitation on me, let that work be broken.
I take dominion even in my workplace.
I understand that I can take dominion in the realms of the spirit.
I am above every battle, I am above every work of the enemy.
Every power of the enemy is under my feet today in the name of Jesus.
I decree and declare that I am covered under the shadow of the Almighty.
My God is my shield and my defense.
Whatever my hand touches shall not be delayed, it shall not be denied.
I will labor in the strength of the Lord.
Today I speak fruitfulness in my career.
I establish these declarations by faith, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Labour Without Reward
segments: Father, remember my seed today.
Remember every toil that I have done.
Father, remember my sacrifice, that my labor will not be in vain.
My toiling will not go without reward, Father, for you are the rewarder.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every spirit holding my harvest, may it be broken now.
In the name of Jesus, I break every spirit of hardship off of my life, off of my seed, off of my household.
I break the hold of hardship in my work, in my finances, in my job, in my career.
Whatever has been robbing from me, whatever has been stealing from me, whatever has been draining me, from today I destroy that power.
Every wicked taskmaster, today I break your power in the mighty name of Jesus.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I arrest that demon that has been destroying my seed.
You spirit of locust, you spirit of canker, come out of my labor, come out of my hard work, in the name of Jesus.
Patterns of toiling and toiling, patterns of hard labor, patterns of sowing and not reaping, I break them in the name of Jesus.
Every cycle of hard labor, be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Every yoke of unprofitable labor, break in the name of Jesus.
Every hard labor without result, every unprofitable work, it is removed from my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today I will not labor in vain, I will not work in vain.
I refuse to work and not profit, I refuse to plant and not reap, I refuse to labor in vain.
I will not labor for another to profit, I will not sow for another to harvest.
In all my labor, I will see profit, I will see benefit, I will see results.
I will profit from the work that I do, I will profit from whatsoever my hands touch.
Father, cause me to labor under your blessing.
I will see the fruit of my labor, I will reap the fruit of my labor, I will enjoy the fruit of my labor.
Whatever I touch will increase, whatever I touch will multiply.
Dryness is not my portion, stagnation is not my portion, penury and hard labor is not my portion.
No more unprofitable hard labor, in the name of Jesus, amen.

title: For My Business
segments: Lord, I make you a partner to my business.
What I earn, you will also have your share.
Whatsoever I touch, let it come in contact with the blood of Jesus.
Whether it is my business partners, be it my clients, let them be purified, for the blood of Jesus flows through me.
Everything that has been a delay in my business, I cancel it.
Everything that stands ahead of me and that is causing delay, I remove in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every barrenness in my business, I rebuke you and I reject you in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every enchantment that is against my business, the fire of the Holy Spirit shall destroy it.
Every plan, every trap, every witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I have power to finish my business.
I have power to accomplish my business.
I decree and declare I have power over my business.
I speak acceleration in my life, in my career, in my business.
I decree and I declare promotion in my business.
I call the customers, I call the clients from the west, from the south, from the east, from the north.
I call them into my business, and they will cause my business to prosper.
Whatsoever I do, the angels of God will go ahead of me.
Angels will meet me when I am doing that business.
I receive the spirit of boldness to go after that business.
I need this dimension, Father, to go higher in my business.
My business shall be expanded.
May my business also explode.
May my bank account speak of your goodness, oh Lord.
Thank you Lord that my businesses are flourishing in the mighty name of Jesus.
It is well with my business.
I receive it in Jesus mighty name. Amen.

title: For Success and Excellence
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I believe today that whatsoever I touch will increase and whatsoever I do will prosper.
Because your spirit indwells me, everything that I touch will succeed.
The spirit that has brought stagnancy and poverty in my life, let this spirit be broken.
Be broken over my career, be broken over my destiny, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I have decided never to stay in the same place again.
What has been holding me and keeping me stagnant, today that comes to an end.
I receive an excellent spirit in the name of Jesus.
Father, because of the spirit of wisdom, let my productivity increase.
May I become extremely productive, oh Lord my God.
Whatsoever I lay my hands on, let it not only prosper, let it also multiply.
Whatsoever I shall lay my hands on, whatever I will venture out to do, it shall succeed in the name of Jesus.
There will be a quickening in everything that I do.
I receive the unction to prosper.
I receive a fresh oil of greatness, the oil of success, the oil of increase, the oil of wealth.
Father, everywhere I go, I will see results, and everywhere I invest, I will see results.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive the ability to make wealth.
I speak success over my business.
I speak success over the divine assignment of God for my life.
I decree and declare that the work you have given me to accomplish will be good and produce good fruit.
I decree and declare that my mind is sharp and sound, that I am set apart from those that are around me, that I produce solutions, and that they never end.
Success I will see when I rise, and success will be how I end each day.
Success will go before me and prosperity will chase me down in the mighty name of Jesus.
Everything that I set to do by the leading of your spirit, I succeed.
I taste good success.
In every season I prosper, in every season I succeed.
I am blessed, I am prosperous.
Prosperity is my portion in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Divine Connections and Helpers
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I call those things that are not as if they were.
I engage with my destiny now.
I engage with my destiny helpers in the name of Jesus.
Let every satanic altar begin to crumble.
Those who are connected to me, be delivered from that altar in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, all my destiny helpers, no matter where they are located, I open their doors.
I release the blessing of God upon them.
Let them be strengthened, and come and join what you have given me to do.
Whatever we will do, it will be unto your glory in the name of Jesus.
Where there is stagnation in my life, I speak acceleration.
The destiny helpers will pursue me, they will seek me, they will find me, and they will help me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Where I have heard no and no and no, and I have begun to be disappointed, I reverse it from today.
I hear yes in my career, I hear yes in my job, I hear yes in my business.
Lord, I thank you for access that you have given me.
Lord, I thank you for divine connections.
Lord God, I thank you for destiny helpers.
I thank you that I will not be denied.
Father, I thank you for favor with destiny helpers.
Father, I thank you for divine connections with those that will facilitate the vision and the purpose of God for my life.
I will not work alone, but angelic assistance is released unto me in the purpose of God.
I have divine help, I have divine strength, I have divine favor.
Every divine connection has been restored unto me.
Every divine partner has been restored unto me.
I am walking in the restoration of divine partnership, of divine association, of divine collaboration.
Cause me to be the destiny helper that men and women search for.
Father, it is established in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Favor with People
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor.
As you found David, as you found Esther, as you found Moses, as you favored them, so have you also favored me.
In the name of Jesus, I clothe myself with divine favor.
Not just favor, divine favor.
When anyone encounters me, they will favor me, because God has favored me.
I was ignored in the past, I was overlooked in the past, I was undermined in the past.
My era of favor has come.
I am favored by God, I am favored by man.
Father, you have favored me first and you have caused man to favor me now.
Whatever room I walk into, Father, you have caused man to favor me.
I thank you that favor precedes me, that it goes into rooms that I have not arrived in yet.
It hunts down opportunities that I have not even put my name in for.
As they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor me.
As they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor my business.
As they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor my career.
I shall be set apart, I shall be sought after and I shall be preferred.
In every negotiation, whatever I say, it shall be favored, for God has favored me.
Everywhere I was resisted, I will be resisted no more.
Where others were denied, I will make headway.
I will not look for men, men will look for me because of favor.
Kings will come to my rising because of favor.
Uncommon favor speaks on my behalf.
The favor of God speaks for my name.
I receive favor in every area of my life.
Divine favor is a shield around me.
Father, I thank you that favor is upon me and it will go before me in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Favor before Authorities
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor.
As you found David, as you found Esther, as you found Moses, as you favored them, so have you also favored me.
Father, I pray for unmerited favor; may your grace be my clothing, may your grace be my covering.
Your grace is able to qualify me where I am not qualified.
Your grace is able to take me to places I have never been.
I declare that anyone that sees my face, as they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor me.
As they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor my business; they will desire to favor my career.
As they set their eyes upon my name, they will desire to favor me.
I am above competition, I am above intimidation, I am above rejection.
The favor of God speaks on my behalf; the favor of God speaks for my name.
Every door that will shut before me, it will open even as I approach it.
Every place I was denied, because of the favor from on high, I will be accepted.
I have been accepted for promotion in the name of Jesus.
That closed door will be open to me because of mercy.
Where I have been resisted, I shall be resisted no more.
Uncommon favor speaks on my behalf.
Favor marks my business, favor marks my career, favor marks the work of my hands.
Everywhere there was shut down, doors are open.
Where others were denied, I will make headway.
I will not look for men; men will look for me because of favor.
Kings will come to my rising because of favor.
I receive uncommon access, I receive uncommon keys.
Whatsoever I touch, God will respond to it; whatsoever I do, God will back me up.
I have God's approval, I have God's wisdom, I have God's understanding.
Favor all around, favor like a shield from today.
Father, I thank you for uncommon favor in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Name and Reputation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, shame has been taken from me.
Your word says you have never seen the righteous forsaken.
When David was rejected, when they saw him to be nothing, you glorified yourself through him.
Father, in every situation of my life today, don't allow me to be embarrassed; don't allow me to fall into shame.
Father, rescue me from shame, the shame of the family, the shame of my own shortcomings.
Today turn me into a vessel of honor, a vessel that men will see and see you.
Let the spirit of shame be broken; let the spirit of ridicule be broken over my life.
The devil is put to shame; witchcraft is put to shame.
There shall be no shame in my career; there shall be no shame in anything to do with me.
My seed will know no shame in the mighty name of Jesus.
So Father, in the name of Jesus, I call myself by the name you have called me.
The world may have called me weak, but you have called me strong.
No one will stop the move you have started with me.
In the name of Jesus, my name is established, and I will live up to my name.
Sickness is not my name, poverty is not my name, calamity is not my name.
None of those are my names; I bear a new name.
I release the names of my situation, and I boldly accept the name that you have given me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I release every blessing attached to my name.
May I be set apart, may I be marked for excellence, may I be marked for favor.
The season of disappointment has ended in my life.
I have entered into my season of honor; God shall honor me from today.
The Lord shall lift me up because I have humbled myself before the Lord.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my days of embarrassment are over; my days of shame are over.
Father, it is my hour, it is my season.
I am in my season of honor in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Delay and Stagnation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, show me your grace and your mercy.
Lord Jesus, have mercy upon me.
Father, today I pray for speed, Father, I pray for acceleration.
Rescue me from where I am, set my feet in a place that they shall not be moved.
Father, I can see where you want me to be, but it seems like there is a force keeping me here.
Every chain in my life that has kept me stagnant, in the mighty name of Jesus, may every chain fall.
These chains must break off my career, they must break off my business, they must break off my finances.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I speak to every single thing that has delayed me.
I decree and declare, chains of delay are broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Demonic powers are broken, satanic resistance is broken, curses are broken.
The spirit that has brought stagnancy and poverty in my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let this spirit be broken.
Be broken over my career, be broken over my destiny.
Every demonic entanglement that has caused delays, by your spirit, reverse it now.
I cancel every delay, I cancel it right now.
Father, give me the grace to execute, remove procrastination from me.
Father, may not a single thing be delayed.
I release acceleration, I release speed in every area of my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, today is the last time I will experience stagnancy.
Let there be a turnaround in my life.
My way has been made straight.
Delay is a thing of the past.
Delay in my finances is a thing of the past, delay in my elevation is a thing of the past.
Every delay is broken, every slowness is broken.
I receive speed in career, speed in business, speed in promotion, speed in progress.
Father, in the name of Jesus, thank you that there are no more delays in my life.
Thank you for restoration and acceleration.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: For Breakthrough
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, you know my life more than I know.
Nothing is hidden from you, my Lord and my God.
Father, I do not want any breakthrough that is independent of you.
Father, remove the veil from my eyes.
Father, change my mind, that I will see as you see.
I want to walk with your timing.
Lord Jesus, I am looking to you, you are the God of suddenly.
That demon that has been holding my breakthroughs, the fire of the Holy Spirit shall destroy it.
No demon will block my breakthrough.
No evil spirit will hinder my elevation.
No witchcraft will hold me back.
I cancel every plan of the enemy, every intention of the enemy to hinder, to thwart or to stop your blessing on my life.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, let every agenda of every agent of the enemy be broken in the name of Jesus.
I break and I reverse every handwriting of poverty and of fruitless effort in my life.
Oh God, cause men to favor me and open doors that no man can shut in the mighty name of Jesus.
I command my breakthrough by the authority and power given to me by the Lord Jesus.
Let it come to pass by the mighty hand of the Holy Spirit.
Father, let there be a suddenly this month.
Father, there will be no more lost time in my life.
Today I possess all my possessions.
I receive that breakthrough, I receive the next level.
I decree and I declare that breakthrough is my portion in the mighty name of Jesus.
I soar above every opposition and I break through on every side.
Father, I thank you that my turnaround has come.
Nothing about my life shall remain the same after this moment.
Thank you, Father, for breakthrough.
I receive it in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Restoration of What Was Lost
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I understand today there is a realm of restoration.
You are the God of restoration.
Father, in the name of Jesus, look upon me with mercy and remember me today.
Father, do not see my failures, do not see my faults, but let mercy speak on my behalf.
Every demonic power, every diabolical spirit that has been stealing from me, in the mighty name of Jesus, I break that power and I recover all.
Everything that the devil stole from me, everything that he has taken from my family, I recover all in the name of Jesus.
Because of the cross, let everything that was stolen from me be restored now.
Father, your word declares if the thief be caught, he shall restore sevenfold.
Whatsoever was stolen, whatsoever was taken, be returned in Jesus name.
Father, restore unto me all the years I have lost, all the time I have lost, any opportunity I have lost.
Father, give me a new beginning.
Father, establish me again, set me back on the path.
Father, in the name of Jesus, all the years I have lost, all the wasted time, I reclaim it in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever I should have been, you are causing me to accelerate to the place that you had ordained for me by now.
In the name of Jesus, I recover my destiny.
Every delay that was not designed by God, I recover my destiny.
There will be no more loss, there will be no more derailing.
Father, restore even better, restore even greater, restore much more than what was taken.
Father, let there be restitution, let there be recompense.
I declare restoration in my life, in my home, in my finances, in my career.
I declare restoration in every area of my life.
Oh God, from this day, restoration is my portion.
Everything pertaining to my life has been restored to me.
Father, I thank you that you have restored unto me all that was lost, all that was broken, all that was destroyed.
Father, thank you for restoration and restitution in every area of my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Direction and Clear Decisions
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I need wisdom today, because I want to know you.
I am tired of leading myself.
Father, I am asking for wisdom, I want to walk on your path.
Your spirit of wisdom will give me direction, your spirit of wisdom will give me clarity.
Father, in the name of Jesus, remove every blindness, may I see clearly in everything you have called me to do.
Father, I need your direction, I refuse to rely on my own understanding.
Father, cause for me to understand the way that I should take.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let the spirit of confusion be broken off my life.
Every power of darkness that has planted seeds of doubt, seeds of confusion in me, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Wherever seeds of confusion were planted, I decree and declare clarity come now in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today renew my mind, remove every program of the enemy within my mind.
Whatever confusion of the devil, let it be pushed out now in the name of Jesus.
Today I receive a clear mind, let my decisions be born of your spirit.
I don't want to make hasty decisions, I don't want any lying spirit in my ear.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may I make sound decisions from today.
Father, give me divine direction in every decision I make, so that I may know when to turn left and when to turn right.
Father, redirect my path and set me on the right path.
Father, open my spiritual ears, that I may receive direction from you.
Holy Spirit, influence my steps, that I do not waste any time.
Lord, remove me from deception.
Lord, remove me from confusion and place me in your perfect will.
From today, I see clearly, I will see through your eyes.
Because I have a sound mind, I will make good decisions.
I thank you, Lord, that you are leading me by your spirit.
Confusion is a thing of the past, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am divinely directed into all things that you have prepared for me, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Wisdom and Understanding
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I need wisdom today, because I want to know you.
I am tired of leaning on my own understanding.
Your word says clearly, anyone who needs wisdom, let him ask.
Father, I am asking for wisdom.
Reveal your ancient paths to me.
Give me the spirit of wisdom, give me the spirit of understanding, and give me divine knowledge that only comes from your spirit.
Let the spirit of revelation rest on me, that I may know your ways.
Father, remove all manner of blindness.
Enlighten the eyes of my understanding, oh God.
Make me of quick understanding today.
Holy Spirit, teach me.
Holy Spirit, guide me.
Holy Spirit, show me what I ought to do.
I reject depending on my own understanding.
I will no longer lean on my own wisdom, but today I receive the spirit of wisdom.
Father, from today, remove every cloud of confusion.
I will not be lost any longer, I will not be in confusion any longer.
Let instruction begin to come, wisdom begin to come, direction begin to come.
Your spirit of wisdom will give me direction, your spirit of wisdom will give me clarity.
May I know which way you want me to go, oh God, may I know every decision you want me to make.
Open my eyes to see you clearly, the path to know which way to go.
Take me by your right hand.
From today wisdom is in my blood, wisdom is my nature.
By wisdom I will be established, by wisdom I will be sustained.
Father, I thank you that even now wisdom is being poured into my spirit in the name of Jesus Christ.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: For My Purpose and Destiny
segments: Father of all spirits, creator of the heavens and the earth, maker of all that is visible and invisible, I call upon your name.
All things were created for a purpose, for you know all things, my Father and my God.
I thought I could lead myself, but I realized I was deceived.
But today, Father, I understand that the only way I can please you is by being in the place of my calling.
Without my calling I am not useful, but with my calling I am complete in you.
Lord, the times that I have wasted, have mercy on me.
The decisions that I have made that have removed me from your purpose, Father, forgive me.
O Lord, today restore me, bring me back to the place of purpose.
Father, in the name of Jesus, reveal your purpose in my life.
Reveal the reason why I was born.
Lord, open my eyes, open my heart, that I may understand and know your purpose for my life.
Father, take over my destiny.
Take over everything that concerns my life.
Every spirit that wants to steal my destiny, be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
Let every obstacle that is standing between me and my destiny be removed in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, I recover my destiny.
In every place where my destiny was derailed, delayed or cut short, today I recover my destiny.
Father, give me the ability to commit, that I will commit to your purpose.
I will not quit on the journey of destiny.
Father, in the name of Jesus, fulfill your work in me.
Cause me to walk in the purpose and the plan that you have predestined for my life.
I will fulfill everything that you have ordained for me.
I ascend into the fulfillment of my destiny.
Nothing shall stand in my way.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my destiny is unlocked, my future is unlocked.
I am entering into my destiny.
I am entering into my destiny.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For a New Season
segments: Father, I thank you for new beginnings.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I switch directions.
I divorce myself from the past.
I divorce myself from past memories.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I put an end to my past.
The frustrations of the past, the difficulties of the past, they are all behind me.
Father, my season of struggle has come to an end.
Every chain, every bondage, every stronghold, every mindset that has kept me from moving in the capacity that you desire, Father, let it be broken today.
Father, shift my dimension.
Father, take me to another level.
Release my new season in the name of Jesus.
Father, help me in my season of transition.
Father, give me the courage to restart.
Father, expand my capacity for the new beginning.
I receive everything new that you have for me.
Whatever you are doing in this season, please don't do it without me.
Fresh grace, fresh anointing over my life for this new season.
Father, in the name of Jesus, it is my season for my own shift to come to pass.
It is time for me to break out and walk into what you have destined for me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I enter into my season.
I enter into my hour, I enter into my moment.
Father, in the name of Jesus, a new beginning has begun for me.
I thank you, Father, that I don't have to hold on to the past.
I shall not be defined by the old things, but I will be refined by the new things.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: While I Wait on God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you and I wait on you.
You are my strength, you are my salvation, you are my hope.
Lord Jesus, I wait on you, renew my strength today.
Renew my strength today in Jesus mighty name.
Father, I ask for forgiveness for every time I have jumped the gun because of zeal.
Have mercy on me, cleanse me today and position me, oh Lord.
Father, give me the grace to be patient, to wait for my time.
Father, help me govern my heart and my desires that I may not move ahead of my calling.
Father, give me strength for this time of drought, that I may withstand.
Help me to hold on, that I don't lose the grip of the promise.
Strengthen me in my patience, Lord, and perfect patience in me, oh Lord.
Father, every spirit that is keeping me from the promise that you have for me, let it be broken.
Everything that would keep me from the promise, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Let the influence of doubt be broken from me.
Let the influence of fear be broken from me in the name of Jesus.
Father, I accept your process, I accept your timing, oh God.
I want to know your timing, I want to walk with your timing.
Lord, whatever you have prepared for me, I await, and I know I am receiving.
Every delay in my life becomes divine preparation.
Every hidden season becomes the womb of manifestation.
I walk in humility, knowing that in due time, he will exalt me.
I am anointed for the promise, and nothing will keep me from the promise.
Father, I believe that this is my season.
I thank you that what I have been waiting for has been released in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Breaking Generational Curses
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I stand as a representative of this bloodline.
Whatever was done by my fathers, by my mothers, that was unpleasing to you, Father, I ask you to forgive us.
Father, I ask you to cleanse us, Father, I ask you to purify us.
Lord, cleanse me from family curse, from every generational spirit.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the spirit of the living God, I separate myself from every generational curse, every calamity of my family.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce and denounce every occultic connection, let it be broken over my life.
Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was entered into on the behalf of my bloodline, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.
That spirit that held my family, those situations that held my fathers before me, by the spirit of God, I rebuke it, I bind it.
Patterns of sickness, patterns of addiction, patterns of failure, patterns of poverty, in the name of Jesus, I disconnect myself.
Every demonic assignment, every demonic agenda over my bloodline, I destroy you, I neutralize you, I terminate your assignment.
Your assignment over my bloodline will never prosper.
Every carryover curse, every carryover debt, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse over my life be broken, every curse over my family be broken, every curse over my children be broken.
Father, use me as a curse breaker in my family.
Use me to end generational patterns, use me to change the story of my family.
Lord, make me the curse breaker in my family, let it all stop with me.
May my bloodline be delivered, may that deliverance begin with me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, generational curses are broken.
Christ is made a curse for me, and I am redeemed from every curse of the law.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from generational curses, I am free from bloodline curses.
I am separated from every curse, I am separated from every generational curse.
No generational curses will flow from me, and no generational curse will flow to me.
Only generational blessing in Jesus mighty name.
No curse will operate in my bloodline, no curse will operate in my generation from today.
I become freedom for my children, I become freedom for my household.
Today I am made whole, today I am made new, today I am made free by reason of the blood of Jesus.
In Jesus name, Amen.

title: Breaking Evil Cycles and Patterns
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, you know my life, you know everything that is in my life.
Father, open my eyes, cause me to see the patterns that happen over and over again.
Anything from my past, anything from the past of my parents, anything from the past of my forefathers, Father, reveal every hidden thing.
Reveal every hidden thing and break it.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic pattern in my life, let it be destroyed.
Patterns of poverty, patterns of limitation, patterns of confusion, patterns of difficulty, be broken now in the mighty name of Jesus.
I renounce every evil pattern, I renounce every negative pattern in the name of Jesus.
Every pattern of almost there but never there, every pattern of starting and not finishing, I renounce it from today.
Every demonic pattern following me because of my connection, because of my association, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I break you, I neutralize you, I nullify you today in the name of Jesus by reason of the blood.
You will not continue in my life, you will not continue in my family, you will not continue in my blood.
Every spirit that has brought patterns into my life, I crush it now.
I will not struggle with what my father struggled with, I will not struggle with what my mother struggled with.
Father, I will not repeat the mistakes of my parents, I will not repeat the patterns that they lived.
From today, I abort every cycle of destruction, I end every cycle of destruction, I come out of every cycle of destruction.
Father, I end every demonic cycle that has been operating in my family.
Every evil cycle break, every evil pattern break, every evil curse break in the name of Jesus.
Father, I have seen the patterns, but today, oh Lord, it ends with me.
By the power of the Holy Ghost and in the mighty name of Jesus, those cycles end with me.
I break out of old ways, old patterns, I break out in the name of Jesus.
Father, do a new thing with me, begin a new pattern with me, begin a new order with me.
I am free from my father by the blood of Jesus, I am free from my mother by the blood of Jesus.
From today in the name of Jesus, I declare a new beginning, I declare a new path.
A new pattern has been written by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Thank you Father for redemption, thank you Father for liberation, thank you Father for freedom.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Freedom from Addiction
segments: Lord Jesus, I come before you genuinely, I come before you honestly.
You know my weaknesses, you know what I struggle with.
Lord, I don't want to be part of what is happening to me, the addictions, the hidden behaviors.
Lord Jesus, I don't want them anymore, I bring it before you.
Today, oh Lord, I renounce and deny all those things that I've been doing in secret.
Lord Jesus, forgive me, Lord Jesus, have mercy on me, Lord Jesus, cleanse me.
I have tried to make myself free, it has not worked, but only you can set me free.
Father, you never created me for bondage, you created me for freedom, I was born to be free.
Father, by reason of the blood of Jesus, may I have a clear conscience before you, may my conscience be purified.
Father, remove this evil program in my mind.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every spirit of addiction, no matter what kind of addiction it is, may those things begin to fall apart.
Smoking addiction, drinking addiction, drug addiction, alcohol addiction, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be broken.
Let my blood be purified and cleansed from every wicked addiction.
Desires that are not of God, I break in the mighty name of Jesus.
I arrest that demon of addiction, I strip you of your power, I strip you of your strength.
I abort your assignment, I end your influence in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I will see every taste of drugs, every taste of evil substances become repulsive to me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, any desire and any addiction, remove it from my subconscious in the mighty name of Jesus.
Thoughts of addiction, out, thoughts of bondage, out, in the name of Jesus.
I cancel every addiction in my bloodline, in my family, Father, I cancel it right now.
Father, where I am weak, be my strength, in that weakness I receive your strength.
Father, I receive grace to overcome this addiction.
Whether it is confusion, whether it is addiction, whether it is limitation, this is the last time.
Because of the blood of Jesus, I am coming out of this cage.
Because of the cross, I am liberated, I am delivered.
Because of the cross today, I decree and declare, the addictions and the chains of sin, let it be broken.
My thoughts are renewed, my habits are renewed, there is nothing of the old that continues to live within me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Divine Protection
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that your word is true.
I thank you that your word will always come to pass.
Father, you are my shield and defender.
Father, I desire that your angels be around me.
Father, cover me today under your wings, according to your words.
Father, let the divine protection you have appointed for those who fear you surround my life.
Keep me hidden in your strength.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak divine protection over my family.
Father, wherever I go, I am protected, wherever I set foot, I am protected, wherever I stand, I am protected.
Every trap set against me to kill me on the road, to harm me on the road, me and my family, in the mighty name of Jesus, I cancel it now.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
You will not touch us, you will not see us, you will not locate us in the name of Jesus.
I decree and declare that a wall of fire will separate me from the darkness and from every device of the enemy.
Let there be a separation between me and those who are planning to cause me harm.
In the name of Jesus, I dip my family into the blood of Jesus.
Today I dip myself into the blood of Jesus.
No accident will find me on the road.
No premature death will find me or my children.
I am under the shadow of the Almighty.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
I am heavily defended and heavenly protected from today.
No arrow by day or by night will harm me or my family.
Premature death is not my portion.
I am protected by God, I am covered by God, I am directed by God.
Angels are around me, angels are before me, angels are behind me.
I will not die, I will live to declare the goodness of God.
Father, I thank you for divine protection from today, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Witchcraft and Evil Arrows
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, because of the blood of Jesus, I am free.
I am free from every arrow of Satan and from every evil enchantment.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Demons have no place in me.
Every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of sorcery, may it be cancelled now in the name of Jesus, upon my children, upon my family, upon my future.
Spirit of witchcraft, in the name of Jesus, be thou broken.
Father, in the name of Jesus, where my name is being mentioned under enchantments and witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever my name is being mentioned, on altars, on offerings, wherever witchcraft is taking place, let it be broken now.
Father, every witch fighting against my life, every sorcerer arising against my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let their charms be broken.
Let their altars be broken.
Every charm against my life, in the name of Jesus, I scatter you.
Every charm that has been invoked against my life, against my family, against my children, in the name of Jesus, let it be destroyed by fire.
Any altar raised against my family, raised against my life, raised against my destiny, from today it shall be broken.
Every wicked altar, every wicked enchantment, wherever you are located, catch fire.
I cancel every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every arrow that is targeting me or my family to kill us before our time, boomerang back to sender.
Every witchcraft enchantment be broken, every witchcraft incantation be broken, every witchcraft spell be broken, every witchcraft decree be broken.
No witchcraft will prevail in my family, no witchcraft will remain in my home.
Every power of witchcraft, every power of sorcery, you are under my feet.
I crush you to pieces, I burn you to ashes in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will not manipulate my life, you will not manipulate my mind, you will not manipulate my home, you will not manipulate my children.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from witchcraft, I am separated from sorcery, I have no more occultic connections.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
I declare freedom from witchcraft today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every curse is broken, every witchcraft is broken, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Spiritual Attacks and Oppression
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus, because it was spilled for my sake.
Father, I thank you, I am secured by the blood of Jesus.
Today I forbid every devil access to my soul, because I give my life to you today.
Holy Spirit, establish me in all truths, that there may be no room for devils.
Lord Jesus, rescue me today from the claws of the evil one.
Deliver me, oh Lord, from every demonic oppression.
Deliver me, oh Lord, from every satanic influence.
Redeem me, oh Lord, from every demonic covenant.
Father, deliver me from every trap of the enemy.
Deliver me, oh God, from every plan of the enemy, deliver me, God, from every attack of the enemy.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic attack upon my family, upon my children, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every demonic lie in my life, let it be silenced now.
Every intention of the enemy concerning my life, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of oppression, every spirit of depression, I destroy you in the name of Jesus.
You will not touch my children, you will not touch my home, you will not touch my life.
Whatever your assignment is, it will not prosper.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic battle in my life, every demonic assignment in my life, is coming to an end.
Father, it doesn't matter how long it has been, today it comes to an end.
Today I enter rest, today I enter peace.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, you evil spirit, you have no room in my life.
I revoke your access by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Light be in my soul, light be in my body, light be in my spirit.
I expose every work of darkness.
Everything done in the dark concerning my life, I expose it in the name of Jesus.
I am delivered, I am free, no evil spirit has any room in me.
No evil assignment will operate in my life.
Witchcraft is under my feet, the works of darkness are under my feet, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Evil Altars and Covenants
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, because of your son Jesus and the amazing sacrifice on the cross, I have been saved.
Father, you know my life, you know everything that is in my life.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce and denounce every occultic connection in my bloodline.
Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was signed on my behalf, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let every satanic covenant, every demonic attachment, every demonic union lose its power.
Let it be nullified, let it be cancelled, let it be dissolved in the name of Jesus.
Family ties that are demonic, marital ties that are demonic, by the blood of Jesus, let them be dissolved.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself, I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant.
Whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously, let that covenant catch fire.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever altar my name has been mentioned, every assignment of the devil upon it, I cancel it now, I destroy it now.
Let my name be erased from that altar, let my picture disappear from that altar.
Every demonic altar that has my name, every demonic altar that has the name of my children, by fire, I scatter you.
Every wicked altar, every wicked enchantment, wherever you are located, catch fire.
Any altar raised against my family, raised against my life, raised against my destiny, from today it shall be broken.
Every demonic altar in my family that has caused me to be useless in life, let that altar be consumed by fire today.
Altars of discord, altars of confusion, altars of stagnancy, altars of witchcraft, altars of limitation, today in the name of Jesus, catch fire.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I dismantle every altar, I dismantle every spirit that is robbing my life of God's blessing.
You unclean spirit, I send you to the pit where you belong.
By the altar of heaven that is covered in the blood of Jesus, I crush your altar wherever it is.
Whatever altar was contending with my family, with my children, with my business, with my career has been destroyed by the heavenly altar.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from every satanic covenant.
I am free from witchcraft, I am free from generational curses, I am free from bloodline curses.
I belong to King Jesus, I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
Every satanic altar has been destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When Enemies Rise Against Me
segments: Lord Jesus, you are my hope, you are the only one who can stand up for me.
Many have risen against me, Father, reveal yourself, Father, show yourself.
Father, fight for me, Father, defend me.
Jesus, you are my salvation, Jesus, you are my high tower.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my spiritual eyes, that nothing the enemy does will be unnoticed.
I decree and declare my eyes have been opened, nothing will happen without my knowledge.
Every plan of the enemy against me and my family, in the mighty name of Jesus, I pull it down.
Every device of the enemy, every meeting in the dark realm, I scatter it now in the name of Jesus.
Everywhere where enemies have gathered around my name and my family's name, may the angel of the Lord scatter them.
Every agenda of the devil, every agenda of witchcraft against my life, I arrest it, I neutralize it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I escape every plan of darkness.
Whatever your assignment is, it will not prosper, whatever your assignment is, it will not be fulfilled.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic intention in my life, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Whatever plans the enemy has for me, let them be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit fighting against me that I don't even know, may that spirit be scattered today.
Father, every word spoken against me, let them be of no effect today.
Whether they were spoken in secret, whether they were spoken publicly, I cancel them in the name of Jesus.
Father, I bind every single thing that the enemy has intended against my family.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Demons have no place in me, demons have no place around my family.
In the mighty name of Jesus, everything that is standing against me, by reason of the blood of Jesus, it is under my feet.
Every work of the enemy that is targeting me, it is under my feet.
I speak confusion in the camp of the enemy.
What the enemy wanted to use for evil, let it be used for good today.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I have the final word in every battle.
My enemies will be disappointed, I will continue to win, I will continue to prosper.
Because of the blood of Jesus, victory is mine, in Jesus name, Amen.

title: For Safe Travel
segments: Father God, thank you for the divine atmosphere of favor that surrounds me.
Because you have favored me, my steps are ordered by you.
Your hand guides my every move and your wisdom lights the path before me.
I am protected because you are my shield, my defense, and my ever present help in time of need.
I have no fear because I know that you are holding me.
I know that I am kept, I know that I am covered, I know that I am sheltered.
Father, continue to strengthen me for the journey ahead.
Keep me from the evil one.
Father, strengthen my body for the journey.
Father, may your grace travel with me today.
Father, redirect my path and set me on the right path.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every trap set against me to kill me on the road, to harm me on the road, I cancel it now.
Any spirit digging my grave, I cancel it now in the mighty name of Jesus.
There is no roadblock of the devil that would say slow down.
No demon will be a speed bump for me.
I escape every trap of the enemy.
I escape every wrong journey in the name of Jesus.
There shall be no accident on the road for me.
A thousand may fall at my side, ten thousand at my right hand, it shall not harm me.
Even if the whole highway collapses, I will walk out of it.
I am blessed coming in and going out.
The same way I left, I am coming back.
No bone in my body shall be broken.
My life will not be cut short in the mighty name of Jesus.
Angels will meet me when I drive, angels will meet me when I travel, I receive it.
Whatsoever I do, the angels of God will go ahead of me.
In you, I dwell secure, in the name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Renouncing Ancestral Covenants
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of your son that has reconciled me unto yourself.
Thank you, Father, for a new covenant.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
Father, I renounce any covenant that my fathers before me and my mothers before me, on both sides of my family, had with anything demonic.
Father, I renounce it, Father, I reject it in the mighty name of Jesus.
I separate myself, I disconnect myself in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I disconnect myself from anything from my father's house, anything from my mother's house, any agreement.
Anything that was passed through my blood, anything that was passed through where I was born, I disconnect myself.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself, I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant.
Whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously, let that covenant catch fire.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, let it catch fire, let it lose its power.
Every occultic agreement, every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was entered into on behalf of my bloodline, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.
Every ancestral spirit, every ancestral covenant, by reason of the blood of Jesus, may it begin to break.
Every generational covenant to evil spirits, to unclean spirits, to demonic spirits, let them be broken because of the blood of Jesus.
I silence every voice in my bloodline.
