There will be no trace of my past, no traces of my ancestors that will follow me.
The only ancestor I recognize is Abraham, and the promises you have established with him that are fulfilled in Christ Jesus.
Because of your blood, I will not have generational curses.
Because of your blood, there is no covenant that will hold me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every evil covenant is broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from every satanic covenant.
I am secure by the covenant of the blood of Jesus.
No generational curses will flow from me, and no generational curse will flow to me.
Because of this covenant, my children shall be preserved.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Renouncing Family Idols and Dedications
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus, because it was spilled for my sake.
I announce it before heaven, the earth, the visible and the invisible, I am bought by Jesus, I belong to Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I break family idols today.
Every idol that has been so forced and ingrained in my bloodline, in my family, in my mind, I break it.
Idols that have perpetuated cycles of poverty and lack, idols that have kept me from being able to honor you, I break them.
Father, today I break every idol in my family, I destroy every idol in my family.
Father, reveal every hidden idol in my heart.
I tear down every idol, I scatter every idol, Father, I cast them down and I cast them out in the name of Jesus.
I will love no other god but you, I will honor no other god but you.
That demonic dedication over my life, made unknowingly, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Spirit of sorcery, occultic covenants, I command you out.
I break every attachment of evil, I break every satanic connection, I break every occultic connection.
I break every attachment of the past, I break every link from the past in the mighty name of Jesus.
Break that link that is still claiming me, break in the mighty name of Jesus.
Freedom from every altar of witchcraft, freedom from every shrine of witchcraft that has been raised against anyone connected to me.
Let every evil thing done against me and my family be destroyed now in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today, whatever defiled me is cancelled by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Whatever altar was contending with my family, with my children, has been destroyed by the heavenly altar.
Father, I dedicate my home to you, I dedicate my life to you.
Whatever is not of you, let it be removed today, let it be destroyed today.
Today I forbid every devil access to my soul, because I give my life to you today.
Lord Jesus, lead me, Lord Jesus, guide me.
Father, I am secured by the blood of Jesus.
Father, I thank you for liberty, Father, I thank you for freedom in the name of Jesus.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Familiar Spirits in My Family
segments: Lord Jesus, Son of David, purify me by your blood.
Sanctify me by your blood.
Lord Jesus, help me, you are my only help, I look to you.
In the name of Jesus, every ancestral spirit, every wicked spirit, come out of my life.
Every power of darkness, every ancestral spirit, every ancestral covenant in my family, by reason of the blood of Jesus, may it begin to break.
Ancestral spirits, I command you in the name of Jesus, I make you powerless.
You ancestral spirit, you have been talking to me, I remove you from my ears in the name of Jesus.
You are silenced, I take power from you, I take strength from you in the name of Jesus.
You will not take me to an early grave, you will not destroy my future.
Ancestral spirit from the waters and from the forest, I disconnect myself from you by reason of the blood of Jesus.
From today, you will no longer see me, you will no longer find me, I will be out of your reach in the name of Jesus Christ.
I am hidden under the wings of the Holy Spirit.
This is not your body, this has never been your body and it will not be your body again in the name of Jesus.
Ancestral spirits, unclean spirit, your time has expired, leave my body and never return again in the name of Jesus.
Those things that followed my family will not follow me.
No bondage shall be on me, no bondage will follow me, no bondage will be part of my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Take away every curse, take away every limitation.
Break the power of witchcraft, break the power of sorcery, break every diabolical power.
Son of David, deliver me, set me free.
Whatever is not from God in my family, may it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
No failure is my portion, miracles are my portion, testimonies are my portion.
Thank you, Holy Spirit, it is finished in Jesus name, Amen.

title: Repenting for My Bloodline
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, give me a prophetic understanding of my entire family.
Father, have mercy, have mercy upon me.
Whatever was done by my fathers, by my mothers, that was unpleasing to you, the decisions they made that are affecting me right now.
Father, I stand as a representative of this bloodline.
Father, I ask you to forgive us, Father, I ask you to cleanse us, Father, I ask you to purify us.
Father, forgive me for the actions of my fathers, forgive me for the actions of my mothers.
Father, every pattern of sin that came from my fathers, from my mothers, I ask you for mercy and I ask you to remove this from me.
Lord, forgive the sin of my fathers, forgive the sin of my fathers.
Rescue me from the patterns that I have maintained from them.
Generational patterns that are still upon me, let them be broken, let them be broken.
Take me to the place where they acted contrary to your word, and let there be correction in that place.
Every demonic pattern that has followed me because of my bloodline, let them be cancelled now in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will not continue in my life, you will not continue in my family, you will not continue in my blood.
As the blood of Jesus cleanses my conscience from every dead works, every dead work that came from my forefathers will die.
Every dead act from my forefathers that is manifesting in me, it shall end with me.
My whole family story will be rewritten.
In the name of Jesus, may my bloodline be delivered, and may that deliverance begin with me.
Let freedom come to my bloodline, oh God, and let it begin with me.
May my bloodline be purified, God.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, may I be delivered, may I be cleansed.
Father, use me as a curse breaker, use me to change the patterns of my family.
Let every bondage that has held my family be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Those patterns that are in my family, in my bloodline, that are not of Christ, I let it go.
Father, I thank you that because of the blood of Jesus I am no longer under a curse.
I am in Christ, therefore I am a new creation.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Breaking Self-Curses
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by your altar that stands before you, by the power of the Holy Spirit, purify my lips.
Lord, forgive me for speaking against my identity.
Father, forgive me, oh Lord, for every word that I spoke against myself.
Forgive me, Father, for speaking against my destiny.
Father, I renounce everything that I might have spoken against my family, my children, I renounce it.
The things that I might have uttered when I was angry, I renounce it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I cancel every negative word I have spoken.
Words I spoke as a child, words I have spoken as an adult, words I have spoken in pain, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Father, every idle word that I spoke out of woundedness, out of unforgiveness, out of anger, out of disappointment, I cancel it now in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce every single curse that I have spoken over myself.
I reverse it, and I speak blessings over myself.
Today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life, that I have spoken concerning my own family.
Words of failure, words of complaining, that have created an atmosphere of demons, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I undo those words.
Every negative word that I have spoken concerning myself, I break it and tear it down in the mighty name of Jesus.
It shall not have a hold on me.
Every word of delay, I cancel it, every word of failure, I cancel it, every word of lack, I cancel it.
Every time I gave up on myself and I spoke those words, oh God, I reverse it.
Every word of failure, may it lose its power because of the blood of Jesus.
Every evil confession from my lips, let it be cancelled now.
I renounce those words today.
I am not defeated, I am not broken, I am not confused, I am not stagnant.
Everywhere where my confession agreed with the enemy, today, Father, I neutralize, I cancel, and I erase by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Father, all that I speak from this day, let it be words of life, let it be words of hope, let it be words of truth.
I declare blessing over myself, the blessing of the Lord over myself.
My truth is the truth that God has spoken over my life.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: Breaking Word Curses Spoken against Me
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, every word spoken against me, let them be of no effect today.
Whether they were spoken in secret, whether they were spoken publicly, I cancel them in the name of Jesus.
Father, every single word that was spoken against me to try to tear me down, I cancel it now in the name of Jesus.
I nullify, I neutralize every evil word that was spoken against me.
Every evil ordinance ordained against me, be broken in the name of Jesus, and let it be blotted out now.
Father, every evil spoken against me, let it be blotted out as if it was never there.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I silence every word of the accuser.
Every word of slander to destroy my future, I make it powerless.
Nobody will hear those words, nobody will be moved by those words.
Every word that is resisting me in the atmosphere, words of sorcery, words of witchcraft, spells, in the mighty name of Jesus I pull them down.
Wherever my name was spoken and it was released contrary to what God has said about me, I pull it down now in the name of Jesus.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I condemn every voice, every demonic voice, every satanic voice.
Every whisper of defeat, every whisper of death, every whisper of failure, every whisper of sickness, every whisper of poverty, be broken in the name of Jesus.
Whether it be a whisper, whether it be a spell, Father, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
No word that is contrary to the word of God will take root in my life.
I condemn every voice that is speaking against my destiny in God.
No other word, no other tongue, no other judgment shall be established over my life contrary to what God has said.
Every word curse, every word spoken, every enchantment spoken, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every effect and every damage of enchantment spoken over my life, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Today I come out of agreement with the voice of the enemy.
Every word from the enemy, through men, through women, through my elders, through my friends, whatever means the enemy used, I disconnect from that word.
Today I disagree with every word that says I will not make it.
Father, the words that the enemy spoke over me that I accepted as truth, uproot them even now.
Wherever there was a word spoken against me, I cancel that word now in the name of Jesus.
Father, your word alone shall be established over me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For Deliverance from Demonic Oppression
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you, you are my help, you are my hope, you are my strength.
Father, remember me today, save me, oh Lord, redeem me, oh Lord, with a mighty deliverance.
Any chain, any oppression, any demonic influence in my life, Father, deliver me with a mighty hand.
Set me free from this demonic oppression.
Lord Jesus, have mercy on me, if there is anything hiding in me, Lord Jesus, deliver me.
Anything that is in me that did not come from you, I command it now to leave me and never return.
Every evil spirit that has deceived me that I should not live in rest, I command that tormenting spirit to come out of my life.
Spirit of anxiety, spirit of confusion, spirit of worry, leave my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every demonic pattern in my thoughts, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every entity living in me, I command them to leave me, I command them to be evicted out of my body.
My body is the temple of the living God.
You demon tormenting my mind, you demon tormenting my family, come out in the name of Jesus.
There is no agreement with you and I, there is no fellowship with you, I come out of every union with you.
I speak to every demonic power, I speak to every satanic power, I denounce you and I renounce you.
I have nothing to do with you, I belong to Jesus.
Whatever is hidden in my life that is of demonic origin, that has been controlling my mind, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Light be in every hidden place in my life, light be in every hidden place in my heart.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, you have no room in my life, you have no place in my life.
I revoke your access by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Every yoke on me, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, the days of struggling with evil spirits have come to an end.
I am free of every demonic oppression, I am free of every demonic power, I am free of every stronghold.
Darkness, you have no room in me, darkness, you have no place in me.
From today, the power of the Holy Spirit shall flow through me, and I shall fulfill my destiny.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against the Devices of the Devil
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, open my eyes to understand.
Father, give me spiritual understanding in Jesus mighty name.
Father, I thank you in the name of your son Jesus, my precious father, my good God, my redeemer, my deliverer, and my savior.
Father, I pray that you wash me, cleanse me of every unclean work.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I acknowledge you today that you are the author of my life.
I have realized that all the detours in my life is because I failed to acknowledge you.
I did pray, but I acknowledged the devil.
I decree and declare that every accusation of Satan to turn God against me, to turn me against God, may that plan be destroyed right now in the name of Jesus.
May the knowledge of the Spirit be inside of me.
Every lie and deception of the devil will be destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus.
The devices of the devil, the greatest weapon of Satan, will be made of no effect in my life.
Every lie of the devil must be submitted to the word of God.
Every lie of the devil must be arrested by the word of God.
God, let every thought that contends with your truth, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Let every stronghold in my mind be broken.
Let every stronghold that would try to take over my mind, let it be broken now in Jesus name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I command you, take everything you have put inside of me and never return again.
Whatever you have joined yourself with me with, may it be broken in the name of Jesus Christ.
The devil is under my feet.
Jesus has given me victory over curses, victory over limitation.
I have overcome in the name of Jesus.
Lord Jesus, thank you for setting me free.
Thank you, Father, for freedom in Jesus name, Amen.

title: Against Evil Arrows
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak divine protection over my family.
I establish a law of protection over my family.
Father, every arrow that has been shot out of the darkness against my life today, I disconnect it in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
You will not touch me, you will not see me, you will not locate me in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow shot against my bloodline in order to bring death, today I reverse every arrow back to sender.
Every assignment of death will not touch me, every assignment of death will not touch my family.
I will not die, I will not be destroyed, I will not be derailed by the plan of wickedness.
Every arrow of premature death, every agenda, you are broken in Jesus name.
I break you in the name of Jesus.
Every accident that is targeting me or my family, every arrow that is targeting me or my family in order to kill us before our time, I reverse you back to sender.
Your assignment is broken, your assignment is neutralized, your assignment is nullified today.
I cancel every agenda of death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will never find your target, you will never land, you will never accomplish your mission.
I arrest you in the name of Jesus and I divert you back to sender.
Every assignment of death is neutralized, it is nullified by reason of the blood of Jesus today.
Father, every arrow of destruction, every arrow of affliction, sickness will not come near my family in the name of Jesus.
Father, arrows that are intended for people will not catch my family by mistake.
Father, you will keep me from the arrow that flies by day.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am under the shadow of the Almighty.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
I am heavily defended and heavenly protected.
From today, no arrow by day or by night will harm me or my family.
My family is protected, my family is heavenly guarded, my family is defended in the mighty name of Jesus.
I shall live and not die.
Thank you, Father, for divine protection from today in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Uprooting Evil Plantings
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, you know my life and nothing is hidden from you, my father and my Lord.
Whatever Satan has planted in my heart and planted in my mind to prevent me from seeing your goodness, Father, I command it out of me in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every power of darkness that has planted evil seeds in me, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Seeds of doubt, I break you.
Seeds of fear, come out from me now in the name of Jesus.
Everything that is in me that was not born of the Spirit of God, may it be removed from me now in the name of Jesus.
Lord, remove the seeds that came from the wrong tree.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every wicked seed within me, let it be removed now.
Every wicked seed, oh God, that has been sown into my ground, pull it up, God, destroy it, God.
Every wicked seed of fear, God, let it be consumed by fire.
Every word that the enemy has spoken to destroy my destiny, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
May every word of defeat be uprooted, may every word of shame be uprooted from me now.
Let every seed that was trying to strangle your word be uprooted from me now in the name of Jesus.
Whatever seed of darkness has been planted into my children, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
Everything that you did, everything that you have left, everything that you have planted, I command it out in the name of Jesus.
Every residue, every residue, be purged now in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today every root of evil within me, Father, uproot it by your spirit.
Every unfruitfulness within me, let it dry from the roots.
Uproot every tree that has caused bitterness.
Uproot every tree that has caused delay.
Oh Lord Jesus, plant a new seed in me that will reverse all the past bad fruits that have been in me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, water what you have planted in me.
I am planted in the mission of God.
Father, I thank you that I am planted and my roots go deep.
Nothing shall remove me from that which you have destined for me.
In the name of Jesus, I declare I am free today, Amen.

title: Pulling Down Strongholds
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I call on your name.
You have given me authority and power to pull down every stronghold.
You have given me authority to pull down every satanic force, to pull down every demonic power.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every stronghold in my mind, may it be broken.
Oh God, let every stronghold in my mind be broken.
God, let every thought that contends with your truth, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Let every prison of my memories, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let every thought that is not of God, thoughts of defeat, thoughts of confusion, thoughts of weakness, thoughts of limitation, let it be brought down.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I pull down every stronghold in my mind.
Everything that is trying to control my mind, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let it be brought down.
Every confusion, every chaos, every wicked seed planting in my mind, let it be brought down.
The voices that said I cannot make it, the voices that said I am a failure, the voices that said I am nobody, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
Father, I pull down depression, I pull down oppression, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pull down every demonic lie.
I pull down every distortion of the enemy in my life, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every chain, every bondage, every stronghold, every mindset that has kept me from moving in the capacity that you desire, Father, let it be broken today.
Everything in my life that has made me to conform to this world, in the mighty name of Jesus, may it be broken.
Every mental stronghold, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Wherever there are old thought processes that would stand in the way of revelation, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Whatever mindsets are in me that are keeping me from your promise, let it be broken.
That spirit that has been holding my destiny, that spirit that has kept my family in bondage, may those powers be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every stronghold, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let this mind be in me which was also in Christ Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I secure my mind.
My mind is protected.
My mindset is transformed, my thinking is transformed, the past no longer will hold me.
I am free of every demonic oppression, I am free of every stronghold, I am free in Jesus name.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: Closing Every Open Door to the Enemy
segments: Lord Jesus, secure my family today.
Father, that the enemy will have no way, no entrance, no access to destroy my family.
In the name of Jesus, search me and know me.
Scan me, oh God, and whatsoever is unlike you, uproot it now.
Anything that is unlike you, oh God, dwelling on the inside of me, uproot it now.
Every access point that the enemy has used before, today, Father, I shut every access, I shut every entryway.
Break every hold, close every access point in the name of Jesus.
Because I am a descendant of David through Christ Jesus, I make a decree.
You will not touch my family, you will not touch my finances.
I lock the door that gave you access.
Father, in the name of Jesus, no premature death shall come close to my door.
Every untimely death, I draw the line by reason of the blood of Jesus.
You have no access to my life, you have no access to my children, you have no access to my loved ones.
You will not come near my house, you will not come near my family.
Whatever agenda of the enemy is against me and my family, let it be scattered in the name of Jesus.
Let whatever they attempted to do to me, let it return to sender.
Every pattern of the past, every destruction of the past, every struggle of the past, Father, I eliminate it from my family.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, no cycle shall be perpetuated.
No curse shall be perpetuated by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Father, today I speak security, I speak a defense of God, a wall of fire.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, there is no claim over my life, no claim over my children.
I have been redeemed by the blood of Jesus.
My family is secured, my family is kept, my family is preserved in you in the name of Jesus.
No harm shall befall my family, no death shall befall my family.
Father, every enemy of my life has been scattered.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free, I am redeemed.
In the name of Jesus, I declare I am free today.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Territorial Spirits
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, everywhere any principality is planted in the territory you are sending me to, before I even get there, I pull down every principality and power.
For I am seated in heavenly places, higher than those principalities.
Today, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I walk on those principalities and powers, I pull them down.
Father, in that sphere where any principality has been ruling, I pull down every principality.
Before I get there, I pull down every power with them.
That wicked assignment, Father, will not ruin that territory, it will not ruin anymore.
Father, I set a perimeter.
That is the domain that will never again have access, that is the domain that will never again have influence in the name of Jesus.
Father, by legal right, by reason of the blood, by the authority of Christ, I take over that territory.
I pull down that dominion, I pull down the influence, I pull down the reign in the name of Jesus.
Let every territorial demon be pulled down in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every enchantment on any altar with my name, with my family's names, let that altar be destroyed.
In the mighty name of Jesus, my feet are walking on a higher ground.
I am seated in higher ground, far above principalities and powers.
I am walking far above principalities and powers, far above every work of the enemy.
Nothing can hold me back, nothing can hold me down, nothing can chain me down.
Today I have all authority and power.
Father, in the name of Jesus, anoint my feet for a new territory.
That whenever I set my feet there, I will possess it.
Your word says wherever the soles of my feet shall touch, I shall possess it.
Every territory I ever visited, every territory that I will visit, I will possess it.
I possess that neighborhood, I possess that community, I possess that nation, I possess it now in the name of Jesus.
The anointing to possess territories is mine, I receive.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I expand my borders, I expand my territory.
I receive the spirit of boldness, like Joshua received boldness.
Father, I will be established with no contention, with no opposition, to establish your will, to establish your agenda.
In Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: Against the Spirit of Rejection
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I surrender myself in your capable hands.
Do not forsake the works of your hands.
I am your child.
Without you, I can accomplish nothing.
And I thank you, oh Father, because you have made me a conqueror.
You have made me victorious.
Today, oh Lord, I reject the image of men.
I reject every voice that has silenced your voice in me, in the name of Jesus.
Every wicked seed of rejection, let it be consumed by fire.
Every wicked seed of being overlooked, let it be removed now.
Every wicked seed of embarrassment, let it be broken.
Every wicked seed of comparison, let it be destroyed.
Rejection, come out of me.
Every curse of rejection, break in the name of Jesus.
Every curse over my destiny be broken.
I break it by fire.
Every cycle of disgrace, every cycle of rejection, I break it today in the name of Jesus.
Every cycle of rejection, every cycle of pain, break in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever it came from, wherever it started, I declare I bring a stop to it today.
That cycle break in the name of Jesus.
There is no room for rejection in the mighty name of Jesus.
I reclaim my identity in God's territory in the name of Jesus.
I declare this day that everything I put my hand to is blessed.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Failure at the Edge of Success
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I welcome your work within me.
Holy Spirit, I welcome your work within me.
Father, from today these things shall not be part of my family.
I renounce every evil pattern, I renounce every negative pattern.
Every pattern of almost there but never there, I renounce it from today.
Every pattern of almost making it but never making it, I renounce you in the name of Jesus.
Every pattern of starting and not finishing, I renounce you in the name of Jesus.
Every pattern of beginning and failing at the finish line, I break you in the name of Jesus.
Every pattern of failure at the edge of success, I renounce you in the name of Jesus.
You will not continue in my life.
You will not continue in my family.
You will not continue in my blood.
The voices that said I cannot make it, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
The voices that said I am a failure, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
Today, I condemn failure.
I condemn the thoughts of failure.
Every tongue that resists the manifestation of your will for my life, I condemn you in the name of Jesus.
No failure shall touch my life.
Father, lift me beyond this place.
I will not remain at this level.
I will not remain at this stage.
I decree and declare, everything that was not working will begin to work.
Everything that was broken will be mended today.
I decree and declare upon my life, it shall be well with me.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Victory in Legal Battles
segments: Father, let my case come before you today.
Visit me, oh Lord, and show me mercy.
Father, you know my case, you know my situation.
God, I need your intervention.
Let not the day go by without you turning the case in my favor.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let every court case that is set against me come to an end today.
Let every accusation against me come to an end today.
God, wherever there has been a case raised against me, let today it be cancelled.
Wherever there is a court judgment that has been raised against me, let it come to an end today.
Let it be turned over today.
Let it end in my favor today.
I cancel any kind of prison or jail in the mighty name of Jesus.
Whatever is planned against me, let it be exposed.
Let every demonic thing be exposed.
Every device of the enemy, every meeting in the dark realm, I scatter it now in the name of Jesus.
Everywhere where enemies have gathered around my name and my family's name, may the angel of the Lord scatter them.
I scatter every court case.
God, every agenda in dark realms, every agenda with my name, I scatter it.
Any connection that is calling my name for evil, I disconnect in the name of Jesus.
Give me the wisdom to navigate, give me the wisdom to move.
Let that court case be under my feet.
Whatever that battle is, it is under my feet.
Every battle that I am in, I have overcome in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Strength in Trials
segments: Lord Jesus, I trust you in the midst of the fire, I trust you in the midst of the storm.
I trust you in the wilderness, I trust you in all situations, Lord.
Father, I understand that your people are empowered in the wilderness.
It is in that place that I receive strength, it is in that place that I learn intimacy.
Father, today by your spirit, I surrender myself to your process.
I understand that it will end in praise, I understand that it will end in glory.
Father, I am ready, give me endurance, give me strength to walk through storms.
I thought these troubles were because you have forsaken me, but now I know it is the opposite.
Strengthen my faith today, that my faith should not fail.
Strengthen me today, that I may be able to walk through the fire, that I may be able to persevere when everything seems lost.
Father, give me endurance, give me the ability to endure, that I may receive what you have for me.
Remove the ability to quit from me.
My suffering is not in vain, you are using it to perfect me.
Holy Spirit, I know that you are with me.
Strengthen me, fortify me against every storm, against every weapon of the enemy.
Today I know that no weapon will prosper against me in the name of Jesus.
Give me the strength to stand, that when the storms come, the spirit of God will raise a standard.
Father, show me your strength in the midst of this storm.
Give me the ability to persevere, so that when the fires increase, my vision can be sharper and better.
Father, I receive strength, no matter what turbulence will come, whatever storms will rise.
I am anchored in you, I shall not be moved, I shall not be shaken.
Holy Spirit, hold me up, sustain me, O Lord, that my feet will remain on solid ground.
Father, I will testify, even in this situation I already have a testimony.
I will not drown here, this is not my end, this is my elevation.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: For My Identity in Christ
segments: Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of sonship, that I belong to you.
Not by my own declaration, not by my own decision, but by your own divine word, you chose me to belong to you.
Lord Jesus, I want to know you so that I may know me.
I have walked for so long with the wrong identity, I have walked for so long with the wrong name.
Lord, forgive me for taking on the wrong identity.
Father, forgive me, oh Lord, for every word that I spoke against myself.
Father, in the name of Jesus, help me, open my eyes by your spirit that I may indeed know who I am.
Today I refuse, I will look at myself through your eyes and I will know myself through your word.
Father, renew my mind, so that I would not see myself through circumstance, but I would see myself through your word.
Father, I reject a carnal mind, today by the spirit of God I receive the mind of Christ.
Every mentality of defeat, every thought of failure, every thought of rejection from you, Father, I cast it down.
Every insecurity I pull down, every fear I pull down, every limiting belief I pull down in the name of Jesus.
Every voice that will come against my sonship, I silence it now.
Every fear, every intimidation, every low self-esteem, be broken off me in the name of Jesus.
Father, I return to self, I receive my sonship as you have put your seal upon me.
I am not confused about who I am.
I know I am crucified with Christ, and I know that it is Christ that lives through me.
I am not only a child of God, I am also a son of God.
I am a coheir with Christ, what you have given to him, you have also given to me.
Because of what the Lord Jesus has done for me, I am accepted, I am forgiven, I am righteous, I am holy.
I am seated with Christ Jesus in heavenly places, above principalities and powers.
The old has passed away, I am a new creation in Jesus.
Father, today I know I am blessed, today I know I am favored, today I know I am yours.
Father, thank you that I know who I am.
Father, never allow me, Lord, to ever forget who I am.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Prayer of Repentance
segments: Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I humble myself before you.
I come before the throne of grace, that I may receive mercy.
Father, be merciful unto me, forgive me of all my sins.
I have sinned against you with my actions, with my heart, with my words.
I have sinned against you consciously, and I have also sinned against you unconsciously.
All my ways before you have been wrong, oh my Lord and my God.
Please forgive me for my disobedience, for my stubbornness, and every immoral act and impurity.
I repent of every iniquity, I repent of every sin, everything that I have done.
You know all the secret things; my life is naked before you.
Lord, I am sorry for hurting you, for grieving you, for grieving your spirit.
Oh Lord Jesus, have mercy on my soul.
Lord Jesus, have pity on me, I am a sinner, I have walked the wrong way.
Father, I thank you that no sin is greater than the cross.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray that you forgive me of every sin, that you will cleanse me and purify me.
Take all iniquity from me by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Let every trace of sin, let the root of sin's power in my life, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let it be dismantled in the name of Jesus.
Father, separate me from sin, purify me now.
Father, cleanse me now according to your tender mercies and your loving kindness.
I repent of those ways; I do not desire to go back to them.
Help me to stand upright; save me, O Lord, rescue me, O Lord.
Lord Jesus, sanctify me, purify me.
Father, I thank you that by your words my conscience is purified.
I am even divorced from iniquity.
The guilt of sin will no longer follow me.
The effects of sin are out of me, because of your grace, because of your mercy.
Thank you for forgiving me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Purity and Victory over Temptation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I cry for purity today.
Sanctify me, O Lord, purify me, O Lord.
Mold me and shape me into the image of your son Jesus.
Remove all impurities from me.
Every thought that is controlling my actions, Father, take it away from me today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, purify my mind, purify my soul, purify my body.
Father, in the name of Jesus, save me from temptation.
Save me from every trap of the enemy.
Father, from this day forward, I curse every plan of the enemy in the name of Jesus.
Father, from this day forward, may I never fall victim to the plans of the enemy.
God, deliver me from temptation, give me mastery over my soul.
Give me strength by your spirit that I would resist the enemy.
Father, deliver me from temptation, that I would not give in to the weaknesses of my flesh.
Lead me not into temptation, but give me victory over the enemy.
Father, I desire to be purified, I desire to be sanctified.
May the root of any sin within me, may it be uprooted.
May sin's power lose its power in the mighty name of Jesus.
Today I receive power to resist every devil, to resist every demon, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am immune to falling.
I am immune to temptation in the mighty name of Jesus.
When I stumble I will not fall, when tempted I will not succumb.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I bind all that is unclean, I bind all that is unrighteous.
I ascend into total holiness.
Holy Spirit, purify me, sanctify me, that devils and demons will not have a place.
Give me the ability to remain in your holiness, to walk in holiness.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Prayer of Salvation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of salvation that you have given to all men.
Whoever will confess the Lord Jesus, whoever will call on the name of the Lord, they shall be saved.
Lord, I want you; I choose you.
I am not choosing you because I am afraid of hell; I am choosing you because I love you.
And you loved me first.
I have sinned against you; I have gone against your will.
But your love is greater than my mistake.
You provided the cross to restore me.
Lord Jesus, forgive my sins, cleanse me, purify me.
Father, I pray, may you come into my heart.
Fill me with your spirit and lead me from today.
Give me a repentant heart, a heart that is ready to turn away from sin.
Holy Spirit, I invite you to walk with me and to change me.
Grant me eternal life today, that I may be with you forever.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I give you my life; my life belongs to you.
You are my Lord and my Savior; you are my Redeemer.
Lord Jesus, I recommit my life to you.
Father, I thank you that at the feet of your cross I am redeemed.
Because of the cross, I have a guarantee of salvation.
Father, today in the name of Jesus, I receive the forgiveness of sin.
I belong to Jesus.
I belong to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
Thank you for saving me, thank you for forgiving me, thank you for rescuing me.
I will follow you for the rest of my life, even into eternity.
Sustain me by your grace, because on my own I cannot.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For the Fire of the Holy Spirit
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I know by your spirit there is a greater place I should operate from.
Lord, I want your spirit to be upon me.
Forgive me for putting out my flame.
Lord Jesus, I want to burn again.
Oh my Father, baptize me with fire.
Baptize me in the fire that cannot be quenched.
Holy Spirit, I need you.
Father, as an open vessel, fill me with your spirit to the overflow.
Holy Spirit, come upon me, rest upon me, move within me.
I don't want to be a seasonal Holy Spirit person.
I want to be an everyday, every minute Holy Ghost person.
Consuming fire, consuming fire, consume me today.
Let every work that is not of the spirit be consumed by your fire.
Whatever is in me that is not from you, may it be destroyed now.
Father, let your fire burn over me from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet.
Father, set me on fire.
Father, clothe me with your fire.
Make me a flame of fire.
May I burn for you, Jesus.
Cause me to burn with a desire and a hunger that can never be quenched.
By your spirit, set me ablaze, cause me to burn in the realms of prayer.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive the power of the Holy Spirit.
I want to walk with the power of the Holy Spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, nothing will quench the fire of the Holy Spirit in me.
No matter what the situation, the fire of the spirit shall burn from today.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For Hunger and Intimacy with God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your grace, I thank you for your mercy.
I thank you for your love that continually draws me to you.
Thank you for drawing me closer to you.
Forgive me, Father, for seeking to remain in comfort.
Lord, forgive me for stopping to hunger.
Reignite my hunger for you and remove me from my comfort zone.
Father, I thirst for you.
Father, I hunger for you.
Let me not be satisfied, but may I continue to chase after you.
Holy Spirit, cause me to thirst for you like I have never before.
Nothing can satisfy me except your presence.
Father, give me a hunger for your presence.
Father, I just want to be where you are.
Draw me by your spirit, that I will be thirsty for your presence.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that my intimacy with you will go deeper and will become greater.
I want to walk with you close, like the Lord Jesus did while he was on the earth.
Father, I want more of you.
I want less of me and more of you.
Lord Jesus, I want an encounter, I want to see you.
Father, I will not be satisfied with the encounters of the past.
Stir up my spirit today, Father, to hunger and to thirst after you.
Father, I want your presence.
May I become a house of worship, that your presence remains upon me.
Oh Lord my God, baptize me in your presence again.
Don't send me from your presence without your presence.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: For a Strong Prayer Life
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I come back to you.
Father, I come back to you and I ask you, restore me within yourself.
Holy Spirit, hold my hand, I depend on you.
Father, every procrastination, every laziness, every weakness in prayer, today I rise from that place.
In the name of Jesus Christ, that thing that has dried up my prayer life, I strip it now.
My spiritual life shall be strong again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, ignite my spirit and baptize me by fire.
Remove procrastination of prayer, remove laziness in prayer.
Baptize me with a spirit of prayer.
Holy Spirit, stir up my spirit, that I may become a person of prayer.
My body is your temple, and if you dwell in me, then I ought to pray.
Oh Lord Jesus, cause the hunger of prayer to be in me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my fire to pray.
Increase my capacity to tarry in your presence.
Lord, today, revive my inner man.
Lord, when you push me to pray, I will pray.
By your spirit, set me ablaze, cause me to burn in the realms of prayer.
That when I pray, it will be like a burning furnace, that demons will flee.
Reignite my prayer life today in the mighty name of Jesus.
May my prayers be effective.
May no prayer ever fall to the ground in the name of Jesus.
Father, you will teach me how to pray by your spirit.
Father, prayer will be my lifestyle after today.
There is a shift in my prayer life.
In Jesus mighty name, amen.

title: For Spiritual Sight and Discernment
segments: Father, I pray in the name of Jesus.
Father, touch my spirit today, and make me alive once more.
Father, create in me a clean heart, and renew a right spirit within me.
Remove the heart of stone, and give me a heart of flesh, in the name of Jesus.
Father, give me a seeing heart, a hearing heart, and an understanding heart.
Let me not hear according to my own opinion, but let me hear according to your spirit.
Father, open my eyes that I may see as you see.
I refuse to see as men see.
Holy Spirit, help me to know the hearts of those around me, both evil and good.
Sharpen my discernment, that I may know good from evil.
Father, I don't want what seems right; I want to know what is right.
Let the spirit of discernment, the spirit of wisdom and revelation, be manifest within me, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Open my eyes that I may see the devices of the enemy.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my spiritual eyes, that nothing the enemy does will be unnoticed.
Father, give me spiritual perception, that I will know them by the spirit; I will know no man by the flesh.
Give me discernment to know those who are sent for me.
Father, I tune out every spirit whispering and murmuring in my ear.
Open my ear so that I hear your voice.
Every word that the enemy has spoken into my ear, I reject you, and I receive your revelation.
Give me insight of the hidden things, insight of the things hidden in darkness.
I refuse to remain in blindness.
Father, remove every hardness of hearing and every dullness of hearing from me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I declare scales are falling off of my eyes today.
Those things I couldn't discern, today by your spirit, I can discern them.
I am walking in the discernment of the spirit.
Let all my life be illuminated by discernment today.
I am able to discern what is for me, and I am able to discern what is coming before me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Dreams and Visions from God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the ability to dream.
Father, give me the ability to see visions with the inner eye again.
Where there were times that were difficult, and I lost my vision and I lost my dream, restore it again unto me, O Lord.
Let the inner eye be lightened, O God.
I redeem every lost dream.
May I dream dreams, and may I see visions opened and closed.
Give me the ability to dream, that I may receive your instruction.
Every spirit that has hindered me from dreaming or stealing my dreams where I cannot remember, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Lord, let your instructions that are hidden within me be revealed to me in a dream or a vision of the night.
I know you have already spoken today by your spirit.
Make me aware of what you already spoke.
Father, I pray that my ability to remember your instructions and your direction will be so activated in me that I will not miss what you have for me.
Lord, revive the realm of dreams for me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let me be elevated, that the skill of dream interpretation will indeed be in me.
Father, give me the grace to understand my dreams and to receive interpretation for them.
Help me to understand what you are saying.
Father, you are the God who reveals; give me revelation with details, and give me the ability to comprehend it.
Every vision that is from darkness, that is from the evil one, I arrest it.
I receive discernment to distinguish between that which is of God and that which is of darkness.
In the name of Jesus, I will see visions of God.
My visions will be born of the spirit.
What I shall see shall come to pass.
May I see visions of the spirit; may I see visions of God.
Every dead vision in my life is being revived in the name of Jesus.
The dreams and the visions that you placed on the inside of me, they will not die, but they will live and come to fruition.
I will dream again.
I will dream again.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For a Fresh Anointing
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, thank you for the anointing.
Father, I failed to recognize the anointing that has been on my head.
But today I recognize it, today I am reminded of it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, have mercy on me.
Let the blood of Jesus speak on my behalf today.
Father, I make room for the oil that will descend upon me.
Father, I empty myself.
Father, I desire fresh oil.
Replenish the oil upon my head.
Where my oil dried up, Father, refill it.
Let it run from the crown of my head even unto my feet.
Fresh oil upon my head, fresh grace upon my head, fresh anointing upon my head.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I am ready for a fresh anointing for the next dimension of my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, anoint me today for your own glory.
For I no longer want to do things in my strength, God, but by your anointing.
May your anointing unlock my understanding.
God, increase my capacity so I will carry your presence.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let your power rest on me and let it be permanent.
Let it never lift again.
My father and my God, let yokes in my life be broken because of the anointing.
Because of the anointing, let every limitation be broken.
Because of the anointing, let every stagnancy be broken.
Father, let your oil activate who you made me to be before the foundations of the world.
Let your oil rest on me, let your oil remain with me.
I receive fresh oil.
From today, my life will never be the same.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Church and Nation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, your word says the earth is the Lord's and all those who are in it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I know this land is my inheritance.
As long as I am here, Lord, bless this nation, bless my nation.
Forgive my sins, forgive me where I have turned away from you.
Father, I pray for mercy and forgiveness for even those who have walked away from you.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that you by your own spirit will bring peace, you will stabilize the country that I am in for your own sake.
I pray for wisdom and understanding for the leaders of my nation and for all those who are in power.
Father, I pray that unity will come into this country and that people will know that we agree on more than we disagree on.
Father, Satan is after our children, but today I secure the children of this nation.
No plan of the wicked one shall prosper upon them.
I cover them under the protection of the blood of Jesus.
I come against any form of calamity, I destroy every work of the enemy in the mighty name of Jesus.
I build the hedge of protection around my city and my nation in the mighty name of Jesus.
I decree and declare that the spirits that control my nation will bow when I mention Jesus.
Principalities and powers, evil and wicked spirits, submit to the authority of God in the name of Jesus.
I lift your church before the throne of grace, that your word, as it comes forth, will accomplish what you have sent it to do.
Let your light be a beacon in this city and in this nation.
My father and my God, may my church be the preservation, the salt and the light of this city and this nation.
May this house cause souls to come from everywhere in the world to be saved, to be restored, to be delivered.
Father, because your children are in this nation, may this nation be preserved, may it be defended by heaven.
As long as your people are in this nation, may the economy never fail, for the sake of your people.
Father, for the sake of your children that are in this nation, I decree and declare souls will come to Jesus.
The nation will know Jesus, the nation will submit to Jesus, the nation will chase after Jesus.
By the spirit of Jesus, I speak into the womb of my nation.
You will come back to God, you will find Jesus again.
There will be a great harvest of souls unto the kingdom of God.
My nation is blessed in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Words and Confession
segments: My father and my God, only you possess life-giving words.
Father, I desire to speak spiritual words that give life.
I repent, Father, for speaking by what I felt and not by faith speaking your word.
Wherever I have spoken untrue words, Lord, today I come before you in repentance, have mercy on me.
Where my mouth has been caught in gossip, Father, purify me, sanctify me, cleanse me from every contamination in the name of Jesus.
The things that I might have uttered when I was angry, I renounce it.
Teach me to guard my mouth, that I don't speak rashly.
Father, I cancel every negative word that proceeded from me.
Let it be erased from the spirit and also in the physical.
May there be no trace to those words any longer.
Every word of delay, I cancel it, every word of failure, I cancel it, every word of lack, I cancel it.
Every word of defeat, let it lose power because of the blood of Jesus.
Holy Spirit, as you did it for Isaiah, touch my lips with a coal from your altar.
May my lips be redeemed from the past.
Father, by your fire, purify my lips, that life may proceed from it.
Father, anoint my lips, anoint my tongue.
Father, give me new words today.
Remove the evil words that were within me, put new words within me.
Help me today to respond to your word and never to the enemy's word.
Father, establish my words.
May my mouth be filled with your words and your decrees.
I decree and declare oil upon my lips, anointing upon my lips, the power of God upon my tongue.
I will speak words of life, words that will shift my destiny.
Truth will be found on my lips.
From today, not one word that I speak shall fall to the ground.
Every word I speak is a sword that establishes me in the purpose of God for my life.
Every word that I speak shall come to pass, in Jesus name. Amen.

title: When I Am Spiritually Dry
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive grace.
Lord, do not let your rain dry up in my life.
Father, do not let the rain dry up in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every dry place in my life be consumed with the rain, the divine rain, in the mighty name of Jesus.
May the spirit of Jehovah enter me.
Father, let every spirit that was planning to dry me up, in the name of Jesus, be broken.
Today that spirit of dryness is broken.
I come against any form of weariness, any form of tiredness, I come against it in the mighty name of Jesus.
Anything in me that is not of God, come out of me in the name of Jesus.
Father, let your fire consume whatsoever is not of you.
Father, I set my life ablaze.
Every place that was comfortable, let my heart begin to burn with fire.
Let the fire be rekindled in me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let the fire be rekindled in me in the mighty name of Jesus.
The divine rain, baptize me with continual hunger and fire.
Oh Lord, in the mighty name of Jesus, let me have a continual hunger and fire to stay in your presence.
Baptize me with continual power, with continual fire in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I am ready for your visitation.
Father, today express yourself through me.
Your word says, oh Lord, I will run and not faint, I will walk and not be weary.
May the rain be refreshing in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my days of dryness are gone.
Father, no more dryness today.
Father, as oil never dries, I will never dry in the name of Jesus.
I will not dry up in this season.
Dryness is eradicated from my life.
I am empowered by the Holy Spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Consecrating Myself to God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I surrender to you.
By the precious blood of Jesus, you have given me a way to purity.
Father, today I surrender my heart.
Whatever I am still holding on to, Lord Jesus, I release it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I desire to be purified, I desire to be sanctified.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, may I be purified, may I be sanctified from every stain of sin.
May that root that makes me to fall, Father, may it be removed from me.
Father, help me today, Lord, let sin lose its power on me.
May the patterns of sin be broken in me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, purify me today, sanctify me today, that I may be useful in your hands.
May my hands be clean today.
Father, sanctify my heart, Lord, purify my heart, that I may see as you see, that I may walk as you walk.
Purify my mind, purify my soul, purify my body.
Father, sanctify me for your use.
Father, purify me for your use.
Make me a vessel of honor today.
Mold me and shape me into the image of your son Jesus.
Do with me what you desire, oh Lord my God.
I want to be all you want me to be.
Lord my God, I want to see you, I want to walk with you.
Finish your work in me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Because your oil is upon me, I am consecrated.
God has separated me for himself.
I am set apart from the foundations of the earth.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am redeemed, I am sanctified, I am purified.
No sin will hinder me from what God has for me.
I start afresh with you in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Take Communion
segments: Father, I thank you in the name of Jesus that your body was given for me.
Lord Jesus, I thank you for your body that was broken for my sake.
Father, I thank you for your blood, the blood of your son Jesus, that was shed for me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I am a member of your body.
In you there is no sickness, in you there is no death.
Father, as I partake of your body, I see myself restored.
Healing is my portion, restoration is my portion.
As I partake of your body, may I break out of every grave, every coffin and every limitation.
Because I am a member of your body, I cannot remain in the grave.
As I am joined to your body, let everything of self die, but let the life of Christ also manifest in my flesh.
The body of Jesus was broken for me, let my body be put together.
Let there be no sickness in my body, let there be a sanctification from every evil.
Father, I am not partaking of symbols of your body, I am partaking of your body, that your life may be in me.
May your life be in me, Lord Jesus.
My Father and my God, as I partake of this cup, your word says life is in the blood.
As I take this, let the life of my Lord Jesus Christ flow through me.
Every iniquity, every addiction, any kind of bondage, any demonic affiliation, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let it be broken.
By your blood, I have overcome every work of the enemy.
Sorcery, witchcraft, occultic powers, I have overcome because of the blood of the Lamb.
The blood of Jesus has liberated me, it has cleansed me, it has purified me.
And the blood of Jesus speaks on my behalf.
Because of your blood I am redeemed, and redemption is my portion.
As I partake of this, I am entering into a new life.
Lord, as I partake of this, I am established in the work of the cross.
As I partake of this cup, I am walking in victory.
Let it be so now, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: When I Fast
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you because you are my strength.
My strength comes from you, and the power within me comes from you.
Father, give me the grace to be strengthened throughout this fast.
Father, let your grace sustain me all the way to the last day.
I will not fall off in the middle of this fast.
I will receive every blessing that you have ordained for me to receive through this fast.
All that needs resurrection will receive resurrection because of your grace that is available for me.
Father, I receive grace for this fast.
Where I am weak, where even my body can feel weakened, Father, I receive grace.
Father, where I am weak, your strength sustains me.
Father, let pride be removed from me, that I may receive your blessing.
Anywhere I have been deceived in false humility, today I come out of that false humility.
Father, let me humble myself in truth and in spirit.
I submit myself under your mighty hand, that you would lift me up.
Oh Lord my God, do unto your servant as you desire.
You are the potter and I am the clay.
I surrender myself in your hands, I give myself to you.
Lord Jesus, I want to know you, so that I may know me.
I want to know what you call me.
Father, help me today by your spirit.
Father, I receive more grace today, I receive new mercies today.
May your mercy speak for me, oh Lord Jesus.
Father, I thank you that this petition is granted.
I thank you that you have enlarged me and you have kept me from grief.
Father, as I have begun with you, I will finish with you.
I will finish strong because of grace, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Activating My Gifts and Calling
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, stir up my spirit once again.
Father, as I receive the anointing, let there be an activation, let there be a manifestation of the gifting that is within me.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, may I see through my gift.
May I walk through my gift, may I speak through my gift.
Everything that I do, may it be connected to my destiny and to the manifestation of my gift.
Remove every unbelief in me, remove every doubt in me.
May I see as you see me.
Father, I stir up the gifts that are within me, the gifts that you put inside of me.
Awaken the vision in my heart, awaken that dream today, God.
Everywhere it has been frustrated, everywhere it has been shut down, everywhere it has been quenched, Father, today let it stand back into place.
Father, you have called me to be a solution, you have called me to be an answer.
You have called me to be the expression of your glory, the expression of your voice, the expression of your power.
Every word that is lying dormant, oh God, that you spoke unto me, let it be activated now.
Lord, remove the things that have quenched my spirit.
Father, let rivers of living waters break forth from my spirit.
Any kind of barrier in my mind, in my heart, that is holding me back from total surrender to you, Father, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, I receive the gift of faith.
Where there was fear, let faith arise.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the activation.
From today I will walk in my gift, I will walk in my calling, I will walk in my purpose.
I will no longer walk according to my own understanding.
Father, may you empower me, may you equip me, may you activate me, oh God.
Continually uplift me by your spirit, that everything I do will be driven by purpose.
Those giftings will transform the life of my family, my friends and my children.
Father, from today I will no longer look to the left or to the right in comparison.
I will hold fast to the gift, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For Grace
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I realize today that your love for me is too great, that it is beyond my understanding.
Father, I understand today that my success is not based on my strength, but it is based on you who gives grace.
Anywhere that I have had pride, in my mind, in my speech, in my heart, in my spirit, today I humble myself.
I come out of pride, so that your hand would lift me up.
Father, I humble myself before your mighty hand, that grace would abound towards me.
Today I desire great grace, I desire to walk in a greater measure of grace.
I empty myself that you may fill me, baptize me in grace, strengthen me in grace.
Father, increase my vessel today, let grace upon my life multiply.
Expand me beyond my understanding, that I may be able to carry more of you.
I receive the grace that was upon the apostles, and I receive the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The multiplicity of grace is upon me, and I will never be the same.
Father, in the name of Jesus, more grace upon me.
Father, I pray for an abundance of grace, that even when I fail, because of your grace it will spring me back into your will.
May your grace be my clothing, may your grace be my covering.
Father, I cannot grow beyond the grace that you have placed in me.
Lord, I surrender myself to that grace, may your grace in me grow.
May I walk in the grace that you have bestowed upon me.
Father, I receive fresh grace, grace to see you, grace to walk with you, grace to know you, grace to go higher in you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive grace for the impossible.
I receive grace for the impossible concerning my family, concerning my children, and for the call on my life.
Father, may your grace travel with me today, in every endeavor that I will ever have.
Father, may your grace work for me.
Fresh grace upon my head, fresh oil upon my head, fresh anointing upon my head.
Wherever I go, grace will follow me, grace is my portion.
Grace and mercy shall follow me, because it is my portion, in the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For an Obedient Heart
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I submit myself to your will.
I call you Lord over my life.
I submit everything to you, because you are my Lord.
Father, I surrender my ways.
Father, I relinquish my ways, I relinquish my understanding.
Father, help me to hear your voice.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I correct disobedience in my life.
I correct disobedience in my bloodline.
Let every disobedience be corrected today.
May every trace of disobedience that is within my heart, Father, let it be uprooted.
Every seed of disobedience inside of my heart, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be uprooted.
Sin of resistance to the word of God, let it be uprooted.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, may I be purified.
Every carnality in my life, I surrender it to you.
May I receive the mind of Christ, that I may be obedient to your law, that I may follow your instructions.
I reject carnality, I reject stubbornness, I reject rebellion.
I reject it in the name of Jesus.
Father, give me a strong spirit that will be determined in obeying your command, obeying your desire, obeying your instruction.
Lord, teach me to submit to you.
Let your thoughts become my thoughts, and let your ways become my ways.
Finish your work in me, oh Lord.
I will no longer stand in the way, Lord.
Father, do your will in my life.
I will serve you all the days of my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For the Fear of the Lord
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I humble myself before you.
May the spirit of the fear of the Lord be upon me.
That I may know you, that I may walk with you, that I may experience you.
May the awe of God come upon me.
May the fear of God come upon me.
Lord, let there be the fear of God that rests upon me.
Lord, I repent for being familiar with you.
I repent for being familiar with your presence.
Lord, let me never get used to you, let me never take you for granted.
Father, let me not be desensitized to your power, let me not be desensitized to your goodness.
If there is any pride, if there is any bitterness, if there is anything in me that is contrary to you, Father, purge me from it.
Father, purify me from it so that I may know you.
May the desire to please you be stronger than the pull of temptation.
May the desire to please you be stronger than the enticement of sin.
May no voice be stronger than the voice of your spirit.
Father, keep me in the fear of the Lord.
May my heart be rooted in the fear of the Lord.
May I be of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord.
Teach me to fear you, to reverence your presence, to obey your voice.
Let the fear of the Lord govern my heart, my thoughts, my words, and my steps.
My heart returns to reverence.
I will never lose reverence for you, I will never lose honor for you.
I will be established in the fear of the Lord.
The fear of God is upon me.
Thank you that the angel of the Lord is encamped round about me, because I fear you.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Pride
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I choose today to walk in humility.
Father, I have understood that pride in me can cause you to resist me.
Anywhere that I have had pride, in my mind, in my speech, in my heart, in my spirit, today I humble myself.
I come out of pride, so that your hand would lift me up.
Reveal any hidden pride in me, so that I will turn away from it.
Reveal any hidden pride in my thoughts, in my heart, in my character, in my attitude.
Today I come out of false humility.
Father, let me humble myself in truth and in spirit.
Father, remove out of me everything that is not pleasing to you, everything that is of self.
Remove every pride from me, oh God, remove every self-righteousness from me.
I submit myself under your mighty hand, that you would lift me up.
Father, clothe me with humility.
I pray for a fresh garment of humility.
In my response, in my reaction, in my perception, let humility be my shield.
Father, let me also humble myself, just as my Lord submitted himself to you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me a humble heart.
Give me a heart that is moldable, give me a heart that is yielding.
Give me a heart that is surrendered to you, Father, in all that you do.
Give me meekness today, give me humility today.
Lord, I position myself today in the place of humility, that you may increase the grace over my life.
I choose the place of humility, I make myself of no reputation.
Father, position me in the place of humility, that I may grow in grace.
Help me, Father, to be clothed and dressed in humility.
May humility go before me.
Humility in my innermost part, humility in the intent of my heart, humility in my thoughts.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: For Angelic Help
segments: Father, thank you for the ministering spirits that you have made available to my life.
Thank you, Father, for the angels that you have surrounded me with.
Thank you for every angel that has gone before me, that has protected me when I didn't know.
Lord, I thank you for this amazing mercy, that you have sent your angels to minister to me.
Father, I thank you for the banner of the angelic that is around me.
Father, cause me to be sensitive to the angels that you have assigned me.
Help me to be sensitive, oh Father, to the angels that you have placed in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, the angels of my assignment, may they go ahead of me, that I may fulfill what you want me to do.
May my path be made straight.
Lord, send your angels.
Father, send your angels unto me and strengthen me.
Father, let your angels minister unto me.
I pray for the grace that you will hold me by the hands of your angels.
May I walk in the realm of angels.
In the name of Jesus, I activate the angels of favor in every area of my life.
Angels of grace, in the mighty name of Jesus, I activate you now.
I activate the angels of mercy.
Wherever I am going to stumble, may the angels of mercy lift me up.
I activate the angels of goodness, may goodness follow me.
Anything intended for evil, may goodness prevail.
The angels of God are activated in my life, they are activated in my family.
I am secure in Jesus Christ.
Angels will meet me at home, angels will meet me in my place of work.
Whatsoever I do, the angels of God will go ahead of me.
No evil shall befall me, I am heavenly defended.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: By Reason of the Blood
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your blood.
Father, I thank you for your blood that was for the remission of my sins, for my cleansing and for my purification.
Father, I thank you for the blood of Jesus, because it was spilled for my sake.
I thank you, oh Father, that your blood has been sprinkled in heaven, above all heavens.
Father, I thank you, I am secured by the blood of Jesus.
I was bought by a price, Jesus bought me, Jesus is my Lord, Jesus is my savior.
I announce it before heaven, the earth, the visible and the invisible, I am bought by Jesus, I belong to Jesus.
Father, I thank you for the precious blood of Jesus that is speaking on my behalf right now.
Because of the blood of Jesus, curses are broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am purified from every sin.
I am sanctified from every deed, I am redeemed from every dead work.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every demonic covenant has been cancelled.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, the power of witchcraft is broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, demons have been silenced.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, generational curses are broken.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let every satanic covenant, every demonic attachment, every demonic union lose its power.
Let it be nullified, let it be cancelled, let it be dissolved in the name of Jesus.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Because of the blood of Jesus, demons have no place in me.
Demons have no place around my family.
All my children are in the blood of Jesus.
Anything and everything connected to me is in the blood of Jesus.
Everybody attached to me, Father, is secured by reason of the blood of Jesus.
There is no claim over my life, no claim over my children, no claim over my bloodline.
I have been redeemed by the blood of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free, I am redeemed.
Because of the blood of Jesus, victory is mine.
Father, this is the word of my testimony, in Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: For a Young Person
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I call upon your name.
Lord, I give you my life.
Fill me with the Holy Spirit.
Father, I avail myself for your use.
I avail myself for your purpose, I avail myself for your kingdom.
Father, my strength will fail, my skills can fail.
Father, I understand today that my success is not based on my strength.
It is not based on my ability, but it is based on you who gives grace.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for an abundance of grace.
Even when I fail, because of your grace, it will spring me back into your will.
May your grace be my clothing, may your grace be my covering.
Cause me to go after the dream you place within me, oh Lord.
Father, give me a new beginning with a new life.
Bless me and increase me, never to be in the wrong place again.
You unclean spirit that has brought addiction into my life, never come back.
Every evil confession from my lips, let it be cancelled now.
I cancel those negative words and their effects in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am not defeated.
I am not broken, I am not confused, I am not stagnant.
My lips are the pen of a ready writer.
Whatever I declare today is established concerning my life.
I am blessed, I shall succeed.
I decree and declare, my strength shall increase.
I shall not be weak anymore.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For a Student
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the activation.
Thank you for the creativity, Lord, I thank you.
Father, thank you for the books that you are calling me to write.
Father, I will write those books for your glory.
Father, as I receive the anointing, let there be an activation, let there be a manifestation of the gifting that is within me.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, may I see through my gift.
May I walk through my gift.
May I speak through my gift.
Everything that I do in my studies, may it be connected to my destiny and to the manifestation of my gift.
Remove every unbelief in me.
Remove every doubt in me.
May I see as you see me.
I receive wisdom for the next level of my life in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the powerful name of Jesus, every spirit of bondage, everything that has bound my life, may that chain be broken.
Every limitation that I have faced in my studies shall be broken.
May school loans be cancelled.
Father, you called me not to owe anyone anything.
You called me to be free, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I break free in the name of Jesus.
I will not repeat the suffering of my ancestors.
The altars of my family are broken.
My doors will be open.
I am already lifted out of the cage the enemy thought he could put me in.
God said the struggle is over.
Manifest your glory today, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For a New Marriage
segments: Father, I thank you in Jesus name.
Father, thank you for securing me and covering me and blessing this family in the name of Jesus.
The test of my marriage is a picture of the blessing that is to come.
Father, make this family wealthy.
Bless this family with wealth, bless this family with wisdom, bless this family with strength.
May money never be a problem for my home.
May my path be made straight.
Whatever has been holding my family, may it be broken.
May what has been holding my destiny be broken.
May what has been holding my finances be broken.
May your angels go before me.
The spirit of anti-marriage struggle is breaking today in the name of Jesus.
I release the blessing that prospers upon my marriage.
May my roots flourish from today.
May God elevate me to heights I have never been.
May I know his goodness and his kindness in everything that I do.
May the Lord go ahead of me.
May I be strong in every season.
Today the Lord has lifted up my shame.
The Lord Jesus is giving my marriage a new beginning.
I receive a brand new beginning.
My doors are already open and my family is restored.
That witchcraft is broken, that enchantment has been dismantled.
I have already entered into the center of the will of Almighty God for my life.
Let it be so in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For My Newborn Child
segments: Father, as I dedicate this child to you today, I thank you for the preservation of my child's life, destiny, and purpose in you, God.
Father, I thank you that you are establishing a covering over my child.
I set this one apart for your kingdom.
I set this one apart, Father, for the purpose that you have already ordained from the beginning.
May my child forever stand in your presence.
May my child forever be secure, may my child forever be preserved.
May my child always find their way to you even when they lose it.
May my child never get into anything that they cannot come out of.
Father, rescue my child, secure my child, hide my child's life in Christ and in you in the mighty name of Jesus.
May my child always have the utterance of the name of Jesus upon their lips.
May angels ascend and descend upon my child.
Give me all that I need to raise this child, give me wealth, give me spiritual understanding.
Give me the mantle of prayer, that I be prayerful.
Every intention of the enemy against this child, let it be reversed now.
I decree and declare by the spirit of the living God, whatsoever the condition is, I reverse it in the name of Jesus.
No demon in any form will appear to me or my child ever again.
Anything that would hold my family back, I break it in the name of Jesus.
I decree and declare good health over my baby.
May healing and restoration be my child's portion.
Sickness and disease is not my child's end.
Sickness and disease is not my child's story.
God does not give me things so that they die.
My child will never know the sufferings I went through, the troubles I went through.
My child will be divinely covered and protected.
Let it be established in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Parents of Teenagers
segments: Father, thank you for my family.
Oh my Lord and my God, you called my children, you chose them, you know everything about them.
Father, help my young ones.
Protect them and guard their life, Lord, in Jesus name.
Father, protect my young ones, preserve their life.
Cause them, Father, to be planted in your will, that they will not be taken by the waves of the world.
Let their lives be hidden, that they will not waste time, but become everything you have called them to be in Jesus name.
Father, may my young ones be preserved for your glory.
