Father, touch my young ones, touch my young ones.
Give them continual clarity, and let this fog leave their minds in Jesus name.
Father, remove depression and oppression from my children.
In this hour and this moment, I arrest every demonic power, every demon, every devil of anxiety and of witchcraft over my children.
May your yokes be broken over the young ones.
May no sorcery prevail in the name of Jesus.
Every altar connected to my children, let it be scattered, let it catch fire and be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
The powers of witchcraft and sorcery from a father's side and from a mother's side, you are arrested, you are bound.
Every spirit of addiction and smoking, let it be broken over this house in Jesus name.
Every demonic spirit, every demonic power over my children, be thou broken.
Leave my children, leave my family in Jesus mighty name.
Whatever is not of God, let it come out of my children in Jesus name.
Whatever is not born of God, let it come out in Jesus name.
My children are free from self-hate, free from suicidal thoughts, free from failure in Jesus name.
Father, touch everyone in my family, grace them all, let death be far from them in Jesus name.
Father, help them to be great, send them places.
Use my young ones to be instruments of salvation for many.
All the issues of my family are over, it is over in the name of Jesus.
Thank you Holy Spirit, in Jesus name, Amen.

title: For a Turning Point in My Life
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, let today be the day that there is a shift in my mind.
Let there be a shift in my soul, a shift in everything that has to do with me.
Father, I want to receive your best, you have ordained the best for me.
Father, I am ready for your best.
Father, I am ready for the shift that you are bringing into my life.
My spirit is ready, my soul is ready.
Father, help me in my season of transition.
Father, help me as I restart, as I march forth with what you have given unto me.
Give me grace, Father, give me the courage to restart.
Father, in the name of Jesus, shift me from where I am, take me to another place, a place I have never been.
That I may obtain the promise that you have destined for me.
Father, help me to let go of things that are not profitable.
Father, I let go of the old, I let go of the old mind.
Every thought of defeat, I leave it behind, every thought of failure, I leave it behind.
I break the cycle of struggle over my family, I break the cycle of limitation over my family.
Father, every place where there was delay, every place where there was limitation, every place where there was struggle, every resistance is broken.
Father, let every tide begin to turn, the tide of poverty, the tide of confusion, the tide of limitations, in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today in the name of Jesus, I declare a new beginning, I declare a new path.
I am ready to cross over, out of poverty, out of anxiety, out of limitations.
Father, in the name of Jesus, it is my season for my own shift to come to pass.
It is time for my own turnaround.
In the name of Jesus, my hour has come.
My hour of being shifted has come, my hour of being lifted has come, my hour of being changed has come.
Today is my day of redemption, today is my day of restoration, today is my day of visitation.
From today, my life is changed, from today, my life is shifting.
Nothing in my life will remain the same after today.
Father, with you I cannot fail, in you I am established.
I am changed, I am transformed, in Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: For Strength in Old Age
segments: Father, thank you for long life.
Thank you father for life and life more abundantly.
Thank you father for rejuvenating my body.
Thank you father that strength comes to me now, thank you that my spirit is revived.
Father, in the name of Jesus, revive my spiritual life, revive my physical life.
Wake me up from my slumber today, that I may fulfill what you called me to do.
Father, I receive long life, may I accomplish what you sent me to do.
Give me my heart's desire, that I may see my children's children's children.
Father, I thank you for long life, I thank you for the greater things that you are going to use me for.
I cancel every appointment with death, I cancel every assignment of death.
Father, I cancel the spirit of death, this spirit that has been taking people before their time, let it be destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, today I arrest the power of witchcraft, I arrest the power of sorcery, and I declare freedom and liberty.
No witch can kill me, no sorcery can kill me, no accident will kill me.
Let this death that is looming over me be taken from me in Jesus name.
Every desire of the enemy will never be accomplished in my body.
I shall live and not die.
I shall not perish, I will not die, I will lay down my life in God's time.
Long life is my portion, long life is my portion.
The assignment of death over my life is canceled, I will live until my assignment is fulfilled.
The Lord will satisfy me with long life.
I declare life and life in abundance, I declare long life in the mighty name of Jesus.
I will have long life, everything I do will have longevity.
My family has long life, my children will have long life.
I shall live long in the presence and glory of God.
My hour for rest has come, long life but with rest.
I thank you that today is the beginning of a new life, the beginning of new purpose in the name of Jesus.
Father, I decree and declare long life, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For a New Land and My Papers
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my Lord and my God, you destined me for freedom.
It has never been your desire for me to be bound, to be in limitation and frustration.
I am but the seed of my family, I am not only representing myself, I am representing everybody that is connected to me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, have mercy on me.
Jesus Christ, son of David, have mercy on me.
I receive your mercy, I receive your grace.
I receive grace to get to the destination that you have set for me before the beginning of time.
Father, in the name of Jesus, strengthen me today.
I pray for the grace that you will hold me by the hands of your angels.
Father, strengthen my faith, that my faith will not fail.
By the blood of Jesus, every diabolical covenant will be broken today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, there will be a separation between me and every evil spirit.
You evil spirit, from where you come from, I bind you, I bind you.
In the name of Jesus Christ, what you have put upon me, may it be broken now.
I remove every evil scent that attracts confusion, every evil scent that has drawn evil unto me.
I end delay over my papers in Jesus name.
Curse, be broken, break.
Let doors be open that were never opened in my family in the name of Jesus.
Today I receive every benefit, the benefit of my citizenship, I receive it today.
Today is a shift for me, whatsoever I lay my hands on shall prosper.
Things are being rearranged for me right now, my papers are being released to me.
Visas for my family have been released.
The curse is broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Thank you God, I have my papers, it is done.
Everything in my life is going to shift, everything in my life is going to change.
Whatever is of hell will never prevail over my life.
Thank you Lord, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My New Home
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the spirit of revelation, that I may arrive in the perfect place.
Lord, I receive that new house.
Father, I receive this home for free, because you paid a full price for it and it is mine.
You prepared the land for me, now I am ready to possess it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, strengthen me today for the battles at hand.
Wherever the soles of my feet shall touch, I shall possess it.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every giant occupying my land, every giant will fall.
I break that curse over my home.
I break that thing over my home.
Where that witchcraft is, where those spells were cursed, may it catch fire in the name of Jesus.
May it be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
Father, any link, any connection that is calling my name for evil, I disconnect in the name of Jesus.
May that stubborn mortgage be cancelled.
May that rent be cancelled.
Father, you called me not to owe anyone anything.
My family is free in the name of Jesus, and it begins with me.
Freedom for the whole house in the name of Jesus.
God is with me and God is with my house.
I am planted.
May God establish me in the land.
I possess my possession.
My life is defended, my life is protected, and all that I love is secure in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, in every area of my life, my home will see it.
I will see the goodness of God in the land of the living.
My family will see the goodness of God in the land of the living.
Nothing lacking, nothing missing.
I receive it in Jesus mighty name, Amen.

title: For a New Beginning at Work
segments: Father, I thank you for finding me right where I am, but not leaving me how you found me.
I thank you for elevation, I thank you for establishment, I thank you for acceleration, Father.
Thank you Lord for that new job.
Thank you Lord for the acceleration in that career.
Father, as I stand before you, Lord, I make room.
My capacity is ready, Father, to hold what you have designed for me.
Father, I remove everything that has occupied the space, everything that has limited the space.
I am ready for the new.
I am ready for that new beginning.
I am ready for that new job.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every impurity in my way, every imperfection in my way, in my career and my destiny, I remove it in the name of Jesus.
Mentally, whatever is holding me back, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
May the spirit of hardship be broken over my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every door in my life, may it be open now.
I remove every gatekeeper.
I remove every gatekeeper that is contending with my career.
Let there be an open door.
In the mighty name of Jesus, doors are opening for me.
I command my doors to be open.
I prophesy my career.
It is well with my career.
I receive expansion in my life.
I begin to walk in new territory with victories in the mighty name of Jesus.
Whatever I touch will flourish.
I will never be brought down.
Father, from today I possess my land.
Whatsoever I declare, let it come to pass in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Thanksgiving and Gratitude
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you with everything that is in me.
Father, I am grateful, Father, I am thankful.
Forgive me, Lord God, for forgetting.
I thank you for your goodness and for your mercy.
I thank you for your everlasting love, for your unwavering commitment to me.
Father, I thank you for your grace and your mercy, for your goodness and your kindness.
Father, I thank you for your eternal deliverance.
Thank you, Father, for the sacrifice of your son Jesus upon the cross for my restoration into relationship with you.
Father, I thank you that you did not spare any expense for my redemption.
Thank you, Father, for the gift of salvation.
Thank you, Father, for the gift of eternal life.
Thank you, Father, for life, I thank you for the breath of life today.
Father, I thank you for preserving my life today, I thank you for covering me today.
I thank you, Father, for where you have brought me from.
I thank you for loving me, God, I thank you for keeping me.
I thank you, Father, for snatching me from the enemy's hand.
Father, I thank you that the work of the enemy has been terminated in my life.
I thank you for every shortcoming, because I know you are in the details.
I understand, oh Lord, that all things work for my good, even when I don't understand it.
Father, you have been good to me, Father, you have shown me your mercy.
Because of the Lord Jesus, I have life, I have healing, I have deliverance.
Because of the Lord Jesus, I am covered, I am healed, I am blessed.
Father, I thank you that you have answered me.
I thank you for being my God, there is no God like you.
Your praises will always be upon my lips, I cannot stop praising you.
Be glorified now and eternally in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Morning Prayer
segments: Father, I thank you in the name of Jesus for this beautiful morning.
I thank you for your blessing that is upon me, I thank you for your mercy that covers me.
I thank you for your blood that sanctifies and purifies me.
Father, I thank you that today is a new day for me.
You have shown me mercy again, you visited me this morning.
Your word says your mercy is new every morning.
Father, cleanse me of all unrighteousness and uncleanness.
Take away my sin and iniquity today.
May my yesterday be put away, and give me a new beginning today.
Father, every time I have the breath of life, you have given me another lease to life.
Father, I pray that your will will be done today.
Father, do with me a new thing today, do in me a new thing today.
Show me your grace, show me your mercy, set my feet on solid ground.
May your wonders and your works manifest in my life today.
Father, may my heart hear your voice, that I may receive of you.
I thank you that your goodness will go ahead of me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive this day as the day you have ordained for me.
I receive the best that is in it, because you prepared this day for me.
Father, I thank you that every work of the enemy in my life shall be broken.
Thank you, oh Lord, that the devil is under my feet.
Father, I thank you that today I will be healed, I will be delivered, I will be blessed.
Father, I receive your goodness and your mercy.
I declare your mercy over my life.
Today is my day, thank you for my day, Father.
Today is the day that victory will reign in my life in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Night Prayer
segments: Father, I thank you for your mercy, for your compassion, for your goodness, for your kindness.
I thank you that you never change, you remain the same.
Father, I receive mercy for this evening.
Cleanse me, purify me of every unrighteousness and uncleanness, oh Lord.
Forgive me, Father, where I have missed it.
Father, I am tired, I am weary, I have carried so many burdens, but only you can give me rest.
Father, every burden that I have come with, I cast it on you.
Lord, today I move my heart from worry, I move my heart from anxiety, I keep my eyes on you.
Today I give you all my burdens, today I give you all my battles.
Father, today I leave everything in your hand.
Bring my soul to the place of rest that is in you.
Let my tears be wiped away, let every conflict even within me be resolved.
Father, restore my soul, may I find peace again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever the enemy is trying to do, even at night when I sleep, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Everything the enemy is trying to do over my life, over my family, every night while I sleep, I cancel it.
Every charm, every altar against my life, be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I take control of the night, because night and light are the same to you.
I take charge of the darkness the same way I reign in the light.
That same light will shine in the darkness.
Lord Jesus, I want to enter into your rest.
Give me a calm spirit, a spirit that understands that you have your hand upon me.
Every anxiety and worry be removed, I rest in you.
Every fear be dispelled by your love, I rest in you, God.
God, let there be rest in my children, let my home be full of rest.
I receive your rest today.
I decree that tonight is my night of restoration.
I take my sleep in Jesus mighty name, Amen.
